2. **Number se pehle definition check karo.** Kaunsi category nayi hai, kaunsi deleted aur kaunsi split, yeh NCRB apne footnotes aur glossary mein batata hai. Pehle woh padho.
3. **Nayi row ka koi trend nahi hota.** Section 69 ke 1,325 cases ek baseline hain, aur ho sakta hai rape count ke kuch cases inmein chale jaayein.
4. **Gayab row ka matlab safe saal nahi.** 2023 ke 888 "unnatural offences" cases ki 2024 mein koi jagah nahi hai.
5. **Registration aur crime ek cheez nahi.** NCRB khud warn karta hai ki zyada registered cases ka matlab zyada crime nahi, aur woh har FIR ko sirf ek baar ginta hai, uske sabse serious offence ke naam par [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Zyada tar violence police station tak pahunchti hi nahi: NFHS-5 mein physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali 77% auraton ne na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Naye code ne labels badle hain, unke peeche ki zindagiyan nahi. Agar tumhe kisi sexual offence ki complaint karni hai, toh kisi bhi police station ko use record karna hoga, chahe crime kahin bhi hua ho (Zero FIR). Complaint electronically bhi di ja sakti hai, aur FIR ki copy tumhe free milni chahiye [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

gang-rape-cases-india-three-years.en:
Police in India registered 2,118 gang-rape cases in 2022 [[ncrb-cii-2022]], 1,753 in 2023 [[ncrb-cii-2023]] and 1,537 in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. On a chart, that is a clean downward line, more than a quarter lower in two years. It is tempting to read it as good news. Before anyone does, it helps to know exactly what the line counts, and what it was never built to count.

## Three years of numbers

| Year | Gang-rape cases | All rape cases |
|---|---|---|
| 2022 | 2,118 | 31,516 |
| 2023 | 1,753 | 29,670 |
| 2024 | 1,537 | 29,536 |

Gang rape is part of the rape total, not an addition to it. NCRB's section-wise table splits the rape head by legal section, and gang rape is one of them [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Rape as a whole fell from 31,516 cases in 2022 [[ncrb-cii-2022]] to 29,670 in 2023 [[ncrb-cii-2023]] and 29,536 in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Gang rape fell much faster.

The three gang-rape numbers are close to, but not exactly, like for like. In 2023 NCRB counted gang rape under Section 376D of the IPC, and kept the IPC sections on gang rape of girls under 16 and under 12 in separate columns: 19 and 1 cases, outside the 1,753 [[ncrb-cii-2023]]. The 2024 figure of 1,537 includes 30 cases involving girls under 18 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], and it combines cases under the old IPC with cases under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), which took over on 1 July 2024 [[pib-mha-new-criminal-laws-2026]]. Adjust for all of that, and the registered count still fell.

## Where gang rapes of children are filed

Only 30 of the 1,537 cases in 2024 involved girls under 18 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That is not the number of girls gang-raped that year. It is the number of such cases that stayed under the rape head.

NCRB counts each FIR once, under its most serious offence [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Child rape booked under the POCSO Act's penetrative assault sections, even when read with the rape law, is counted in the POCSO table, and gang rapes of children are often registered that way [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That table is large. In 2024 it held 43,313 cases of penetrative or aggravated penetrative sexual assault on girls, more than the entire rape head; the rape table itself recorded just 792 victims under 18 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Consider a hypothetical. A 15-year-old in Bihar is gang-raped by three men from her neighbourhood. Police register the FIR under POCSO, read with the BNS. NCRB counts it once, in the POCSO table, among those 43,313 cases. The gang-rape column never sees it.

The other exit is death. A gang rape that ends in murder goes to a separate head, murder with rape or gang rape, which held 266 cases in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That head combines rape and gang rape, so it cannot say how many involved a group. The 1,537 is a floor, not a total.

## The punishment on paper

Under Section 70 of the BNS, when a woman is raped by a group, each member is guilty of rape. Each faces at least 20 years' rigorous imprisonment, up to imprisonment for the rest of natural life. If she is under 18, the punishment is imprisonment for the rest of natural life, or death [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Anyone accused of gang-raping a girl under 18, or of raping a girl under 16, cannot get anticipatory bail [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Section 70 protects women and girls only. The BNS has no counterpart to the old Section 377 of the IPC, so a group sexual assault on an adult man or a transgender person is not rape under the new code, and cannot appear in this count [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Boys under 18 remain protected by POCSO.

The penalties have only climbed. The 2013 criminal law amendment, which followed the 2012 Delhi gang rape case, set the 20-year minimum for gang rape [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. In 2018 Parliament made gang rape of a girl under 12 punishable with natural-life imprisonment or death [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2018]]. The BNS extends that to every girl under 18.

But punishment arrives only after a conviction. Across the rape head, which includes gang rape, courts convicted in 24.4% of trials completed in 2024, and 1,85,785 cases were waiting at the end of the year [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A survivor need not wait for the verdict for support: NALSA's 2018 scheme sets compensation of Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh for gang rape, and the limits are 50% higher for a minor [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]].

## Is the fall real?

The data cannot say. NCRB itself warns that a rise in registered crime is not the same as a rise in crime, and that steps which make reporting easier, such as e-FIRs and women's help desks, can push numbers up [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The logic runs both ways. A fall in registrations can mean fewer attacks. It can also mean fewer survivors reaching a police station, or cases being recorded under other sections.

Most survivors never reach one. In NFHS-5 (2019-21), 77% of women aged 18-49 who had faced physical or sexual violence had never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

So a falling line should raise questions before it earns a headline:

- Did the fall come from a few states or from everywhere? A drop concentrated in one or two states could reflect a change in policing rather than in safety.
- Did cases move between tables: into POCSO, into murder with rape, or into new BNS sections after July 2024?
- Did anything make reporting harder, such as police refusing FIRs or pressure on families to "settle"?
- Does any survey, not just police data, show the same fall?

Until those questions are answered, 1,537 means one thing: the gang rapes that reached a police station in 2024, were registered as gang rape and stayed in that column.
gang-rape-cases-india-three-years.hg:
India mein police ne 2022 mein gang rape ke 2,118 cases register kiye [[ncrb-cii-2022]], 2023 mein 1,753 [[ncrb-cii-2023]] aur 2024 mein 1,537 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Chart par yeh ek saaf neeche jaati line hai, do saal mein ek-chauthai se zyada kam. Ise achhi khabar maan lena aasaan hai. Par aisa karne se pehle yeh jaanna zaroori hai ki yeh line asal mein kya ginti hai, aur kya ginne ke liye yeh kabhi bani hi nahi thi.

## Teen saal ke numbers

| Saal | Gang-rape cases | Kul rape cases |
|---|---|---|
| 2022 | 2,118 | 31,516 |
| 2023 | 1,753 | 29,670 |
| 2024 | 1,537 | 29,536 |

Gang rape rape total ka hissa hai, usmein alag se judne wali ginti nahi. NCRB ki section-wise table rape head ko legal sections mein baant-ti hai, aur gang rape unmein se ek hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Kul rape 2022 ke 31,516 cases [[ncrb-cii-2022]] se 2023 mein 29,670 [[ncrb-cii-2023]] aur 2024 mein 29,536 [[ncrb-cii-2024]] par aaya. Gang rape usse kahin zyada tezi se gira.

Teeno gang-rape numbers lagbhag ek jaise hain, par bilkul ek jaise nahi. 2023 mein NCRB ne gang rape ko IPC ke Section 376D mein gina, aur 16 saal aur 12 saal se kam ki ladkiyon ke gang rape wale IPC sections ko alag columns mein rakha: 19 aur 1 case, jo 1,753 se bahar the [[ncrb-cii-2023]]. 2024 ke 1,537 mein 30 aise cases shamil hain jinmein 18 saal se kam ki ladkiyan thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]], aur yeh figure purane IPC ke cases ko Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke cases ke saath jodta hai, jo 1 July 2024 se laagu hui [[pib-mha-new-criminal-laws-2026]]. In sab ko adjust karne ke baad bhi registered count gira hai.

## Bachchiyon ke gang rape kahan file hote hain

2024 ke 1,537 cases mein se sirf 30 mein 18 saal se kam ki ladkiyan thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh us saal gang rape jhelne wali ladkiyon ki ginti nahi hai. Yeh sirf un cases ki ginti hai jo rape head mein hi rahe.

NCRB har FIR ko ek hi baar, uske sabse serious offence ke naam par ginta hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. POCSO Act ke penetrative assault sections mein darj child rape, chahe use rape law ke saath padha jaaye, POCSO table mein gina jaata hai, aur bachchiyon ke gang rape aksar isi tarah register hote hain [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Woh table badi hai. 2024 mein usmein ladkiyon par penetrative ya aggravated penetrative sexual assault ke 43,313 cases the, jo poore rape head se bhi zyada hain; khud rape table mein 18 saal se kam ke sirf 792 victims darj hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Ek hypothetical sochiye. Bihar mein ek 15 saal ki ladki ka uske mohalle ke teen aadmi gang rape karte hain. Police FIR ko POCSO mein, BNS ke saath padh kar, register karti hai. NCRB use ek hi baar, POCSO table mein, un 43,313 cases ke beech ginta hai. Gang-rape column use kabhi dekhta hi nahi.

Doosra raasta maut hai. Jis gang rape ke baad murder hota hai, woh ek alag head mein jaata hai, murder with rape ya gang rape, jismein 2024 mein 266 cases the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh head rape aur gang rape ko saath ginta hai, isliye yeh nahi bata sakta ki kitne cases mein ek group shamil tha. 1,537 ek nyuntam ginti hai, poori ginti nahi.

## Kaagaz par saza

BNS ke Section 70 ke tahat, jab kisi aurat ka rape ek group kare, toh group ka har member rape ka doshi hai. Har ek ko kam se kam 20 saal ki rigorous imprisonment ho sakti hai, jo baaki natural life ki qaid tak ja sakti hai. Agar woh 18 saal se kam ki hai, toh saza baaki natural life ki qaid ya death hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. 18 saal se kam ki ladki ke gang rape, ya 16 saal se kam ki ladki ke rape ke kisi bhi accused ko anticipatory bail nahi mil sakti [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Section 70 sirf aurton aur ladkiyon ki hifaazat karta hai. BNS mein IPC ke purane Section 377 jaisa koi section nahi hai, isliye kisi adult aadmi ya transgender insaan par group ka sexual assault naye code mein rape nahi hai, aur is count mein aa hi nahi sakta [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. 18 saal se kam ke ladke POCSO ke tahat surakshit rehte hain.

Sazaayein sirf badhti gayi hain. 2013 ke criminal law amendment ne, jo 2012 ke Delhi gang rape case ke baad aaya, gang rape ke liye 20 saal ki minimum saza tay ki [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. 2018 mein Parliament ne 12 saal se kam ki ladki ke gang rape ke liye baaki natural life ki qaid ya death ki saza rakhi [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2018]]. BNS ise 18 saal se kam ki har ladki tak badha deta hai.

Par saza conviction ke baad hi aati hai. Rape head mein, jismein gang rape bhi shamil hai, 2024 mein poore hue trials mein se courts ne 24.4% mein convict kiya, aur saal ke aakhir tak 1,85,785 cases intezaar mein the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Survivor ko madad ke liye verdict ka intezaar nahi karna padta: NALSA ki 2018 scheme gang rape ke liye Rs 5 lakh se Rs 10 lakh ka compensation tay karti hai, aur minor ke liye yeh limits 50% zyada hain [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]].

## Kya giravat asli hai?

Data yeh nahi bata sakta. NCRB khud warn karta hai ki registered crime mein badhottari asli crime mein badhottari jaisi nahi hai, aur reporting aasaan banane wale kadam, jaise e-FIR aur women help desks, numbers badha sakte hain [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh tark dono taraf chalta hai. Registrations mein giravat ka matlab kam hamle ho sakta hai. Iska matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki kam survivors police station tak pahunche, ya cases doosre sections mein darj hue.

Zyada tar survivors wahan tak pahunchte hi nahi. NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein, physical ya sexual violence jhel chuki 18-49 saal ki 77% aurton ne na kabhi madad maangi, na kisi ko bataya [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Isliye girti line ke headline banne se pehle yeh sawaal uthne chahiye:

- Kya giravat kuch states se aayi ya har jagah se? Agar giravat ek-do states mein simti ho, toh woh suraksha ke bajaye policing mein badlaav ka nateeja ho sakti hai.
- Kya cases ek table se doosri mein gaye: POCSO mein, murder with rape mein, ya July 2024 ke baad naye BNS sections mein?
- Kya kisi cheez ne reporting mushkil banayi, jaise police ka FIR likhne se inkaar, ya parivaaron par "settle" karne ka dabaav?
- Kya koi survey, sirf police data nahi, wahi giravat dikhata hai?

Jab tak in sawaalon ke jawaab nahi milte, 1,537 ka ek hi matlab hai: woh gang rapes jo 2024 mein police station tak pahunche, gang rape ke roop mein register hue aur usi column mein rahe.

global-sexual-violence-numbers-india.en:
Two UN agencies have now counted sexual violence across the whole world. WHO estimates that about 263 million women have been subjected to sexual violence by someone other than a partner since the age of 15 [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. UNICEF estimates that more than 370 million girls and women alive today were raped or sexually assaulted before they turned 18 [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]]. Both are counts of living survivors, not of crimes in one year. India sits inside both, and its own figures look small.

## The global count

WHO's figure, from its 2023 estimates, is 8.2% of women aged 15 and older, and 2.4% experienced such violence in the past 12 months alone [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. WHO warns that the true level is likely much higher, because sexual violence is so stigmatised that many women never disclose it.

Note what it leaves out. It excludes husbands and partners, whose violence WHO counts separately: 24.7% of ever-partnered women aged 15 and older, about 682 million, have faced physical or sexual violence from a partner [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. Count partner violence and non-partner sexual violence together, and about 840 million women, 30.4% of those aged 15 and older, have experienced one or both [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. It also leaves out abuse before age 15, which is where UNICEF comes in.

## Childhood: 1 in 8 girls, about 1 in 11 boys

UNICEF's first global estimates of sexual violence against children, released on 10 October 2024, found that more than 370 million girls and women alive today, about 1 in 8, were raped or sexually assaulted before 18 [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]]. For boys and men, the estimate is 240 million to 310 million, around 1 in 11; the range is wide because data on boys is thinner [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]].

Add non-contact abuse, such as online or verbal sexual abuse, and the figures rise to about 650 million girls and women, 1 in 5, and 410-530 million boys and men [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]].

Boys were a small minority of the child victims of penetrative sexual assault in India's 2024 POCSO records [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A global estimate in the hundreds of millions says what those records cannot: it happens to boys too, at scale.

## Central and Southern Asia's 73 million

UNICEF places India in "Central and Southern Asia". There, an estimated 73 million girls and women alive today, 9%, were raped or sexually assaulted as children. Sub-Saharan Africa has the most victims, 79 million or 22%, and Oceania the highest share, 34% [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]].

Read the two columns separately. India's region has one of the lowest shares and one of the largest counts. UNICEF's regional figure is the closest these global estimates come to India, and India is part of that 73 million.

The low share is not a clean bill of health. Regional shares rest on what survivors tell surveyors. WHO notes that women in more gender-equal societies are more likely to disclose sexual violence, which raises measured figures, while where stigma is high, services are few and reporting carries serious repercussions, the real level is likely much higher than the estimates [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. In a region like South Asia, a low percentage can measure silence as much as safety.

## India's numbers in context

WHO puts lifetime non-partner sexual violence among women aged 15-49 in India at 4.1% (uncertainty range 2.5% to 5.8%), against 4.7% for Southern Asia, 8.4% worldwide and 39.8% in Sweden [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. WHO cautions that such gaps reflect disclosure, stigma and survey methods as well as real differences in violence. Our myth-check on country rankings explains why.

India's own survey shows where much of the missing violence sits. In NFHS-5 (2019-21), 6% of women aged 18-49 said they had ever experienced sexual violence, and among ever-married women who had, 82% named their current husband [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. WHO's non-partner figure leaves husbands out by design. So does India's rape law, under which sex by a man with his own wife, if she is not under 18, is not rape [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. On partner violence, WHO places India among the 33 countries and territory with the highest past-year rates, at 22.4% [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]].

Police records are thinner still. In 2024, police registered 29,536 rape cases and, separately, 43,313 cases of penetrative sexual assault on girls under the POCSO Act [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A 2022 study cited estimates that only about 1% of victims of sexual violence in India report it to the authorities [[bmcph-dandona-rape-data-2022]].

## The adolescent peak

UNICEF found that most childhood sexual violence happens in adolescence, with a significant spike between ages 14 and 17. In fragile settings, such as places with weak institutions or large numbers of refugees, slightly more than 1 in 4 girls are raped or sexually assaulted in childhood [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]].

India's police data points the same way, in different age bands. Of 44,567 child victims of penetrative sexual assault recorded under POCSO in 2024, 16,801 were aged 12 to 16 and 23,497, or 52.7%, were 16 to 18 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Part of that bulge may come from cases arising from teenage relationships, which NCRB does not count separately; under POCSO, any sexual act with someone under 18 is an offence whatever the "consent". Even so, the global and Indian figures point to the same stretch of life, roughly Class 9 to Class 12. Safety lessons that stop at "good touch, bad touch" for small children stop too early.

Read these global counts as a correction to India's small numbers: what reaches a survey or a police station is a fraction of what happens. If someone tells you, believe them first.
global-sexual-violence-numbers-india.hg:
Do UN agencies ne ab poori duniya mein sexual violence ki ginti ki hai. WHO ka estimate hai ki lagbhag 263 million auraton ne 15 saal ki umar ke baad kisi partner ke alawa kisi aur se sexual violence jheli hai [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. UNICEF ka estimate hai ki aaj zinda 370 million se zyada ladkiyon aur auraton ke saath 18 saal ki hone se pehle rape ya sexual assault hua [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]]. Dono zinda survivors ki ginti hain, ek saal ke crimes ki nahi. India dono ke andar hai, aur uske apne figures chhote dikhte hain.

## Global ginti

WHO ka figure, uske 2023 estimates ke mutabik, 15 saal aur usse badi umar ki auraton ka 8.2% hai, aur 2.4% ne aisi violence sirf pichhle 12 mahino mein jheli [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. WHO chetavni deta hai ki asli level shayad kahin zyada hai, kyunki sexual violence par itna stigma hai ki bahut si auratein kabhi kisi ko batati hi nahi.

Dekhiye yeh number kya chhod deta hai. Isme husbands aur partners shaamil nahi hain, jinki violence WHO alag ginta hai: 15 saal aur usse badi umar ki ever-partnered auraton mein se 24.7%, yaani lagbhag 682 million, ne partner se physical ya sexual violence jheli hai [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. Partner violence aur non-partner sexual violence ko saath ginein, to lagbhag 840 million auraton ne, yaani 15 saal aur usse badi umar ki 30.4% auraton ne, inmein se ek ya dono jheli hain [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. Yeh number 15 saal se pehle ka abuse bhi chhod deta hai, aur yahin UNICEF ki baat aati hai.

## Bachpan: 8 mein 1 ladki, lagbhag 11 mein 1 ladka

10 October 2024 ko jaari UNICEF ke bachchon ke khilaaf sexual violence ke pehle global estimates ke mutabik, aaj zinda 370 million se zyada ladkiyon aur auraton, yaani lagbhag 8 mein se 1, ke saath 18 se pehle rape ya sexual assault hua [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]]. Ladkon aur aadmiyon ke liye estimate 240 million se 310 million hai, lagbhag 11 mein se 1; range badi hai kyunki ladkon par data kam hai [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]].

Non-contact abuse, jaise online ya verbal sexual abuse, bhi jod dijiye, to figures badhkar lagbhag 650 million ladkiyan aur auratein, yaani 5 mein se 1, aur 410-530 million ladke aur aadmi ho jaate hain [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]].

India ke 2024 ke POCSO records mein penetrative sexual assault ke shikaar bachchon mein ladke ek chhota sa hissa the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Kai sau million ka global estimate woh kehta hai jo yeh records nahi keh paate: yeh ladkon ke saath bhi hota hai, bahut bade paimaane par.

## Central aur Southern Asia ke 73 million

UNICEF India ko "Central and Southern Asia" region mein rakhta hai. Wahan aaj zinda andaazan 73 million ladkiyon aur auraton, yaani 9%, ke saath bachpan mein rape ya sexual assault hua. Sabse zyada victims Sub-Saharan Africa mein hain, 79 million yaani 22%, aur sabse bada hissa Oceania mein hai, 34% [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]].

Dono columns ko alag-alag padhiye. India ke region ka share sabse kam walon mein hai aur ginti sabse badi walon mein. UNICEF ka regional figure hi in global estimates mein India ke sabse kareeb pahunchta hai, aur India us 73 million ka hissa hai.

Kam share ka matlab sab theek hona nahi hai. Regional share is par tikta hai ki survivors surveyors ko kya batate hain. WHO kehta hai ki zyada gender-equal samaj mein auratein sexual violence ke baare mein zyada batati hain, jisse measured figures badhte hain, jabki jahan stigma zyada hai, services kam hain aur report karne ke gambhir nateeje hote hain, wahan asli level estimates se kahin zyada hone ki sambhavna hai [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. South Asia jaise region mein kam percentage jitna safety dikha sakta hai, utni hi chuppi bhi.

## India ke numbers, context mein

WHO India mein 15-49 saal ki auraton mein lifetime non-partner sexual violence 4.1% (uncertainty range 2.5% se 5.8%) aankta hai, jabki Southern Asia ke liye yeh 4.7%, poori duniya ke liye 8.4% aur Sweden ke liye 39.8% hai [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. WHO chetavni deta hai ki aise gaps mein violence ke asli farq ke saath-saath disclosure, stigma aur survey ke tareekon ka farq bhi hota hai. Countries ki ranking par hamara myth-check iski wajah samjhata hai.

India ka apna survey dikhata hai ki chhooti hui violence ka bada hissa kahan hai. NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein 18-49 saal ki 6% auraton ne kaha ki unhone kabhi na kabhi sexual violence jheli, aur aisi ever-married auraton mein se 82% ne apne current husband ka naam liya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. WHO ka non-partner figure husbands ko jaan-boojhkar bahar rakhta hai. India ka rape law bhi yahi karta hai, jiske tahat aadmi ka apni patni ke saath sex, agar patni 18 se kam ki nahi hai, rape nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Partner violence mein WHO India ko un 33 countries aur territory mein rakhta hai jahan pichhle saal ki violence ki dar sabse zyada hai: 22.4% [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]].

Police records aur bhi patle hain. 2024 mein police ne rape ke 29,536 cases register kiye aur, alag se, POCSO Act ke tahat ladkiyon par penetrative sexual assault ke 43,313 cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. 2022 ki ek study ne un estimates ka hawala diya jinke mutabik India mein sexual violence ke sirf lagbhag 1% victims authorities ko report karte hain [[bmcph-dandona-rape-data-2022]].

## Teenage umar ka peak

UNICEF ne paaya ki bachpan ki zyadatar sexual violence adolescence mein hoti hai, aur 14 se 17 saal ke beech isme saaf uchhaal aata hai. Fragile settings mein, jaise kamzor institutions ya bahut saare refugees wali jagahon par, 4 mein se 1 se thodi zyada ladkiyon ke saath bachpan mein rape ya sexual assault hota hai [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]].

India ka police data bhi isi taraf ishaara karta hai, bas age bands alag hain. 2024 mein POCSO ke tahat darj penetrative sexual assault ke 44,567 child victims mein se 16,801 ki umar 12 se 16 thi aur 23,497, yaani 52.7%, 16 se 18 saal ke the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Is ubhaar ka kuch hissa teenage relationships se jude cases se aa sakta hai, jinhe NCRB alag se nahi ginta; POCSO ke tahat 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath koi bhi sexual act offence hai, "consent" ho ya na ho. Phir bhi, global aur Indian dono figures zindagi ke ek hi daur ki taraf ishaara karte hain, mote taur par Class 9 se Class 12. Jo safety lessons chhote bachchon ke "good touch, bad touch" par ruk jaate hain, woh bahut jaldi ruk jaate hain.

In global numbers ko India ke chhote numbers ki correction ki tarah padhiye: jo survey ya police station tak pahunchta hai, woh asal mein hone wale ka ek chhota sa hissa hai. Agar koi aapko bataye, to pehle uska yakeen kijiye.

how-to-read-rape-statistics.en:
Imagine this forward in your college WhatsApp group: "Delhi is India's rape capital, 176.8 per lakh! Only 24% of rapists get convicted, over 2 lakh rape cases are stuck in court, and rapes are falling anyway." Every number in it comes from a real government report. Almost every claim is wrong. Nearly all of them trace back to NCRB's *Crime in India 2024*, released on 6 May 2026 [[theprint-ncrb-cii-2024-release-2026]]. Six questions, asked before you press forward, catch the errors.

## Count or rate?

**Question 1: Is this a count or a rate, and per lakh of whom?** A count is the number of cases police registered: 29,536 rape cases in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A rate divides that by a population so that places of different sizes can be compared: 4.3 rape cases per lakh women [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Large states produce large counts partly because more people live in them, so a ranking by count partly just ranks population.

Then read the denominator. NCRB's rape and crime-against-women rates are per lakh *women*, not per lakh people. India's crime-against-women rate in 2024 was 64.6 per lakh women, from 4,41,534 registered cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. NCRB's general crime tables divide by the whole population, so they print a lower rape rate for the very same cases. A foreign statistic per lakh of total population is yet another base. Numbers on different bases cannot share one chart.

## Registered or happened?

**Question 2: Does it count crimes, or crimes that police registered?** Every figure in *Crime in India* is an FIR, and NCRB says so plainly: "'Rise in crime' and 'increase in registration of crime by police' are clearly two different things" [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. It adds that e-FIR facilities or women's help desks can push a state's numbers up [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

So "rapes are falling" does not follow from 29,670 registered rape cases in 2023 [[ncrb-cii-2023]] and 29,536 in 2024. A dip can mean less violence, or fewer survivors reaching a police station, or more complaints turned away. A 2022 study in *BMC Public Health* cited estimates that only about 1% of victims of sexual violence in India report it to the authorities [[bmcph-dandona-rape-data-2022]]. Treat that as indicative, not exact. Either way, the registered figure is a floor.

The same logic breaks rankings. NCRB warns that more registered crime in a city "is not an indicator of its being comparatively unsafe" [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]].

## Which year, which law?

**Question 3: Which year is this, and under which penal code?** As of 20 November 2026, *Crime in India 2024* is still NCRB's latest edition [[ncrb-website-cii-year-wise-2026]]. A 2026 headline about "new crime data" is describing 2024; nothing official covers 2025 yet. Check the year on every figure, too. The crime-against-women rate was 66.2 in 2023 and 64.6 in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], and a post that mixes the two is comparing different years.

2024 also had two penal codes. The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) replaced the Indian Penal Code (IPC) on 1 July 2024 [[pib-new-criminal-laws-highlights-2024]], so the year's rape cases split into 19,683 under the IPC and 9,853 under the BNS [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The split follows the date of the offence, not of the FIR, so it is not a clean half-year. Section numbers changed as well: rape is now defined in Section 63 of the BNS, not Section 375 of the IPC.

## What got filed somewhere else?

**Question 4: What did the counting rules move to another table?** NCRB follows a "principal offence rule": when one FIR lists several offences, only the one carrying the heaviest punishment is counted [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A rape that ends in murder is recorded as murder with rape. There were 266 such cases, with 274 victims, in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], and none of them is in the 29,536.

Most child rape is elsewhere too. Only 784 of the 29,536 rape cases involved girls under 18, because police book most child rape under the POCSO Act [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That table holds 43,313 cases of penetrative or aggravated penetrative sexual assault on girls in 2024, more than the rape head itself [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A post that quotes only the rape figure has left out the larger number.

## Whose population, whose label, whose data?

**Question 5: Whose population sits under the line?** State and national rates divide by a projected 2024 population. City rates divide by the 2011 Census count, because NCRB has no projections for cities, and NCRB says city and state rates are therefore not comparable [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Delhi registered 13,396 crimes against women in 2024: 130.7 per lakh women as a Union Territory [[ncrb-cii-2024]], but 176.8 in the city table [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Same cases, two population figures 13 years apart. And 176.8 is not a rape rate at all. It covers every registered crime against women.

**Question 6: What does the label actually say, and who wrote it down?** Read column headings word for word. At the end of 2024, 1,85,785 rape cases were pending trial; the larger 2,06,777 is every rape case before the courts that year, old and new [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The 24.4% conviction rate means 5,032 convictions out of 20,587 trials completed in 2024, counted by case [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. It is not the share of rapists, or of registered cases, that end in conviction. Even "rape" means only what Section 63 says: an act by a man against a woman, with husbands exempt unless the wife is under 18 [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. And NCRB says it "has only compiled and collated the data" sent by state and union territory police, and "is not responsible for authenticity of the information" [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Now rewrite the forward so it survives all six questions: "In 2024, police registered 29,536 rape cases, 4.3 per lakh women, plus 43,313 POCSO cases of penetrative assault on girls. Courts convicted in 24.4% of the rape trials they completed that year, and 1,85,785 rape cases were awaiting trial at year's end" [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. It is less dramatic, and every word of it holds.
how-to-read-rape-statistics.hg:
Sochiye, aapke college ke WhatsApp group mein yeh forward aata hai: "Delhi India ki rape capital hai, 176.8 per lakh! Sirf 24% rapists ko saza milti hai, 2 lakh se zyada rape cases court mein atke hain, aur phir bhi rapes kam ho rahe hain." Ismein har number ek asli sarkari report se aaya hai. Lekin lagbhag har claim galat hai. Inmein se zyadatar numbers NCRB ki *Crime in India 2024* se nikle hain, jo 6 May 2026 ko release hui [[theprint-ncrb-cii-2024-release-2026]]. Forward dabane se pehle bas chhe sawaal poochiye, galtiyan khud pakdi jaayengi.

## Count ya rate?

**Sawaal 1: Yeh count hai ya rate, aur kiske per lakh?** Count ka matlab hai ki police ne kitne cases register kiye: 2024 mein 29,536 rape cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Rate us count ko ek population se divide karta hai, taaki alag-alag size ki jagahon ko compare kiya ja sake: har lakh auraton par 4.3 rape cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Bade states ke counts bade hote hain, kuch had tak sirf isliye ki wahan zyada log rehte hain. Isliye count ke hisaab se bani ranking kuch had tak sirf population ko rank karti hai.

Phir denominator padhiye. NCRB ke rape aur crime-against-women rates har lakh *auraton* par hote hain, har lakh logon par nahi. 2024 mein India ka crime-against-women rate har lakh auraton par 64.6 tha, jo 4,41,534 registered cases se nikla [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. NCRB ki general crime tables poori population se divide karti hain, isliye bilkul unhi cases ke liye woh kam rape rate chhaapti hain. Kisi videshi statistic ka base agar har lakh total population hai, toh woh ek aur alag base hai. Alag-alag base wale numbers ek chart mein saath nahi baith sakte.

## Register hua ya asal mein hua?

**Sawaal 2: Yeh crimes ginta hai, ya sirf woh crimes jo police ne register kiye?** *Crime in India* ka har figure ek FIR hai, aur NCRB yeh saaf-saaf kehta hai: "'Rise in crime' and 'increase in registration of crime by police' are clearly two different things" [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Woh yeh bhi kehta hai ki e-FIR facilities ya women help desks kisi state ke numbers badha sakte hain [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Isliye 2023 ke 29,670 registered rape cases [[ncrb-cii-2023]] aur 2024 ke 29,536 cases se yeh nateeja nahi nikalta ki "rapes kam ho rahe hain". Girawat ka matlab kam violence ho sakta hai, ya yeh ki kam survivors police station tak pahunche, ya yeh ki zyada complaints lauta di gayin. 2022 mein *BMC Public Health* mein chhapi ek study ne un estimates ka hawala diya jinke mutabik India mein sexual violence ke sirf lagbhag 1% victims authorities ko report karte hain [[bmcph-dandona-rape-data-2022]]. Ise ek ishaara samjhiye, exact number nahi. Jo bhi ho, registered figure ek floor hai, poori ginti nahi.

Yahi logic rankings ko bhi tod deta hai. NCRB chetaavni deta hai ki kisi city mein zyada registered crime "is not an indicator of its being comparatively unsafe" [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]].

## Kaunsa saal, kaunsa law?

**Sawaal 3: Yeh kis saal ka figure hai, aur kis penal code ke tehat?** 20 November 2026 tak *Crime in India 2024* hi NCRB ka latest edition hai [[ncrb-website-cii-year-wise-2026]]. 2026 ki koi headline jo "naye crime data" ki baat kare, woh asal mein 2024 ki baat kar rahi hai; 2025 ka koi official data abhi aaya hi nahi. Har figure par saal bhi check kijiye. Crime-against-women rate 2023 mein 66.2 tha aur 2024 mein 64.6 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], aur jo post dono ko mila de, woh do alag saalon ko compare kar rahi hai.

2024 mein do penal codes bhi chal rahe the. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ne 1 July 2024 ko Indian Penal Code (IPC) ki jagah li [[pib-new-criminal-laws-highlights-2024]], isliye us saal ke rape cases do hisson mein bant gaye: 19,683 IPC ke tehat aur 9,853 BNS ke tehat [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh bantwara offence ki date se hota hai, FIR ki date se nahi, isliye yeh seedha aadha-aadha saal nahi hai. Section numbers bhi badal gaye: rape ki definition ab BNS ke Section 63 mein hai, IPC ke Section 375 mein nahi.

## Kya kuch kahin aur file hua?

**Sawaal 4: Counting ke rules ne kya kuch doosri table mein bhej diya?** NCRB ek "principal offence rule" follow karta hai: jab ek FIR mein kai offences hon, toh sirf woh gina jaata hai jiski saza sabse bhaari ho [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Jis rape ke baad murder hua, woh murder with rape ke roop mein record hota hai. 2024 mein aise 266 cases the, 274 victims ke saath [[ncrb-cii-2024]], aur inmein se ek bhi case 29,536 mein shaamil nahi hai.

Bachchon ke saath hue zyadatar rape bhi kahin aur gine jaate hain. 29,536 rape cases mein se sirf 784 mein 18 saal se kam umar ki ladkiyan thi, kyunki police bachchon ke zyadatar rape cases POCSO Act ke tehat darj karti hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Us table mein 2024 mein ladkiyon par penetrative ya aggravated penetrative sexual assault ke 43,313 cases hain, jo khud rape head se bhi zyada hain [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Jo post sirf rape figure quote karti hai, usne bada number chhod diya hai.

## Kiski population, kaunsa label, kiska data?

**Sawaal 5: Line ke neeche kiski population baithi hai?** State aur national rates 2024 ki projected population se divide hote hain. City rates 2011 Census ki ginti se divide hote hain, kyunki NCRB ke paas cities ke projections nahi hain, aur NCRB kehta hai ki isi wajah se city aur state ke rates compare nahi kiye ja sakte [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Delhi mein 2024 mein auraton ke khilaaf 13,396 crimes register hue: Union Territory ke roop mein yeh har lakh auraton par 130.7 banta hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]], lekin city table mein 176.8 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Wahi cases, do population figures, jinke beech 13 saal ka fark hai. Aur 176.8 rape rate hai hi nahi. Ismein auraton ke khilaaf har registered crime shaamil hai.

**Sawaal 6: Label asal mein kya kehta hai, aur ise likha kisne?** Column headings shabd-dar-shabd padhiye. 2024 ke end mein 1,85,785 rape cases trial ka intezaar kar rahe the; bada number 2,06,777 us saal courts ke saamne aaye har rape case ka hai, purane aur naye milakar [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. 24.4% conviction rate ka matlab hai 2024 mein poore hue 20,587 trials mein se 5,032 convictions, jo case ke hisaab se gine gaye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh na rapists ka share hai, na registered cases ka jo conviction tak pahunche. "Rape" shabd ka matlab bhi sirf utna hai jitna Section 63 kehta hai: ek aadmi ka ek aurat ke khilaaf act, aur pati ko chhoot hai jab tak patni 18 saal se kam na ho [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Aur NCRB khud kehta hai ki usne states aur union territories ki police ka bheja hua data sirf jod kar pesh kiya hai ("has only compiled and collated the data"), aur woh "is not responsible for authenticity of the information" [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Ab us forward ko aise dobara likhiye ki woh chhe ke chhe sawaal paar kar le: "2024 mein police ne 29,536 rape cases register kiye, yaani har lakh auraton par 4.3, aur saath mein ladkiyon par penetrative assault ke 43,313 POCSO cases. Us saal courts ne jitne rape trials poore kiye, unmein se 24.4% mein conviction hua, aur saal ke end mein 1,85,785 rape cases trial ka intezaar kar rahe the" [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh kam dramatic hai, lekin iska har shabd sach hai.

husbands-missing-from-rape-statistics.en:
Ask India's two main sources of data on violence who commits sexual violence against married women, and you get two different answers. The National Family Health Survey asked women at home: among ever-married women aged 18-49 who had faced sexual violence, 82% named their current husband and 14% a former husband [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. The National Crime Records Bureau counts police cases, and its 2024 table of rape accused has no column for husbands at all, only "separated husbands" folded into a group with friends and live-in partners [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The gap is not a counting error. It is written into the law, and it bends every rape figure India publishes.

## What married survivors told surveyors

NFHS-5 (2019-21) asked ever-married women about specific acts, not legal labels: 6.3% reported sexual violence by a husband, and 4.6% said a husband had physically forced them to have intercourse when they did not want to [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. In any other relationship, that second answer describes rape.

Most of it is never told. Only 11.3% of women abused solely by their current husband had ever sought help, against 23.6% of women abused only by a former husband [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. The gap suggests many women speak only after the marriage ends. The belief that excuses this violence persists too: about one in eight men, 12.2%, said a husband has the right to use force to have sex if his wife refuses [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Our story on NFHS-5's findings behind India's front doors goes wider.

## The exception that empties the column

Police data cannot see any of this because of one sentence in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Exception 2 to Section 63 [[indiacode-bns-2023]]:

> "Sexual intercourse or sexual acts by a man with his own wife, the wife not being under eighteen years of age, is not rape."

If it is not rape, police cannot register it as rape, and NCRB, which counts registered FIRs, cannot count it. A wife who reports forced sex can only have it booked under other offences. In December 2024, Scroll reported, the Union government told the Rajya Sabha it had no proposal to criminalise marital rape, pointing instead to the 2005 Domestic Violence Act and BNS sections on assault to outrage modesty, sexual harassment, assault to disrobe and cruelty [[scroll-no-proposal-marital-rape-2024]]. Whatever is filed that way is counted under those names. Cruelty by husband or relatives was already the largest crime against women in 2024, with 1,20,227 cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]], and the data do not say how many of those files involve forced sex.

The exception has an age floor. In Independent Thought v. Union of India (11 October 2017), the Supreme Court read down the IPC version, Exception 2 to Section 375, so that sex with a wife under 18 is rape, while expressly leaving adult wives undecided [[sc-independent-thought-2017]]. The BNS wrote 18 into the text. The Justice Verma Committee had recommended deleting the exception altogether in 2013 [[thehindu-verma-2013]]; Parliament kept it, as our story on the Verma report recounts.

## Separated husbands: counted, but out of sight

There is one narrow door. Section 67 of the BNS punishes a husband who has sex with his wife without her consent while they live separately, with 2 to 7 years in prison, far below the 10-year minimum for raping any other woman [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. NCRB's rape head includes Section 67 alongside the other rape sections [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

But you cannot find these cases. NCRB's offender table puts "separated husbands" in one group with friends, online friends and live-in partners "on pretext of marriage": 13,879 cases in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. How many were husbands, the table does not say. Even the 14% of married survivors who named a former husband have no matching police number.

## What it does to every national rape figure

Every headline rape number leaves out forced sex by husbands of wives aged 18 or older, unless the couple lives apart:

- **The count.** Police registered 29,536 rape cases in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Husbands living with adult wives contribute none of them.
- **The rate.** NCRB divides cases by all women to get 4.3 per lakh women [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Married women sit in the denominator, but the men married survivors name most often cannot enter the numerator.
- **The known-offender share.** The 96.8% of 2024 cases with an accused known to the survivor [[ncrb-cii-2024]] is calculated without husbands who live with their wives. Counting them could only push it higher.
- **Trends and state rankings.** Every comparison between years or states leaves out the same group. If the exception falls, registered rape would likely rise because the law changed, not because violence suddenly did, the same rule our explainer on the first BNS crime data applies to every new category.

## The challenge before the Supreme Court

In March 2022 the Karnataka High Court held that the exception is not absolute and that a husband who forces non-consensual sex on his wife can be prosecuted for rape under Section 376 of the IPC; the Supreme Court put that ruling on hold in July 2022, and the husband's appeal is now the lead case [[indianexpress-marital-rape-final-hearing-2026]]. On 11 May 2022 the Delhi High Court delivered a split verdict in RIT Foundation v. Union of India: Justice Rajiv Shakdher struck the exception down, Justice C. Hari Shankar upheld it [[scconline-rit-foundation-split-verdict-2022]].

The Union government defends the exception. In an affidavit verified on 3 October 2024 it called marital rape "more of a social issue rather than a legal issue" and said making it rape could be "excessively harsh and therefore, disproportionate" [[union-counter-affidavit-marital-rape-2024]].

On 9 September 2026 a bench of Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana posted the cases for final hearing, to decide whether the exception is valid and whether a husband can be prosecuted while it stands [[livelaw-marital-rape-final-hearing-2026]]. As of 19 November 2026 there was still no ruling; the bench said it would fix the final hearing on 9 or 10 December 2026, before the winter break [[lawbeat-marital-rape-hearing-2026]].

Until then, a wife still has routes, though none will appear as rape in the statistics: a cruelty complaint, a protection order under the Domestic Violence Act, which counts sexual abuse as domestic violence [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]], and, if she is pregnant, an abortion up to 24 weeks as a rape survivor without an FIR [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]], as our story on the 2022 abortion ruling explains. This is general information, not legal advice.
husbands-missing-from-rape-statistics.hg:
Married auraton ke saath sexual violence kaun karta hai? India mein violence ke data ke do main sources se yeh poochhiye, toh do alag jawab milenge. National Family Health Survey ne auraton se ghar par poochha: jin ever-married auraton (18-49 saal) ne sexual violence jhela tha, unmein se 82% ne apne current husband ka naam liya aur 14% ne former husband ka [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) police cases ginta hai, aur uski 2024 ki rape accused wali table mein husbands ka koi column hi nahi hai, sirf "separated husbands", jo friends aur live-in partners wale group mein mila diye gaye hain [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh gap counting ki galti nahi hai. Yeh law mein likha hai, aur India ke har rape figure ko tedha kar deta hai.

## Survey mein married survivors ne kya bataya

NFHS-5 (2019-21) ne ever-married auraton se legal labels nahi, balki asal mein kya hua, woh poochha: 6.3% ne husband ki sexual violence report ki, aur 4.6% ne kaha ki husband ne unki marzi ke khilaaf physically force karke unke saath intercourse kiya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Kisi aur rishte mein yahi doosra jawab seedha rape kehlata.

Zyada tar auratein yeh baat kisi ko batati hi nahi. Jin auraton ne sirf apne current husband ki violence jheli, unmein se sirf 11.3% ne kabhi help maangi, jabki sirf former husband ki violence jhelne wali auraton mein yeh 23.6% tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Isse lagta hai ki bahut si auratein shaadi khatam hone ke baad hi bol paati hain. Is violence ko sahi thehraane wali soch bhi abhi zinda hai: lagbhag har aath mein se ek mard, yaani 12.2%, ne kaha ki agar wife mana kare toh husband ko force karke sex karne ka haq hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. NFHS-5 ne gharon ke andar aur kya paaya, is par hamari story aur aage jaati hai.

## Woh exception jo column ko khaali kar deta hai

Police data yeh sab dekh hi nahi paata, aur wajah hai Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka ek sentence, Section 63 ka Exception 2 [[indiacode-bns-2023]]:

> "Sexual intercourse or sexual acts by a man with his own wife, the wife not being under eighteen years of age, is not rape."

Jo rape hi nahi hai, use police rape ke taur par register nahi kar sakti, aur NCRB sirf registered FIRs ginta hai, isliye woh ise gin bhi nahi sakta. Agar koi wife zabardasti sex ki complaint kare, toh woh sirf doosre offences mein register ho sakti hai. Scroll ki report ke mutabik, December 2024 mein Union government ne Rajya Sabha mein kaha ki marital rape ko crime banane ka uska koi proposal nahi hai, aur iski jagah 2005 ke Domestic Violence Act aur BNS ke un sections ki taraf ishaara kiya jo outraging modesty, sexual harassment, kapde utaarne ke irade se assault aur cruelty ke baare mein hain [[scroll-no-proposal-marital-rape-2024]]. Jo bhi is raaste se register hoga, woh inhi naamon se gina jaayega. Husband ya relatives ki cruelty 2024 mein pehle se hi auraton ke khilaaf sabse bada crime thi, 1,20,227 cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]], aur data yeh nahi batata ki inmein se kitni files mein zabardasti sex ki baat hai.

Is exception ki ek age limit hai. 11 October 2017 ko Independent Thought v. Union of India mein Supreme Court ne iske IPC wale version, yaani Section 375 ke Exception 2, ko read down kiya, taaki 18 se kam umar ki wife ke saath sex rape mana jaaye, lekin adult wives ka sawaal saaf taur par khula chhod diya [[sc-independent-thought-2017]]. BNS ne 18 saal seedha text mein likh diya. 2013 mein Justice Verma Committee ne yeh exception poori tarah hataane ki recommendation di thi [[thehindu-verma-2013]]; Parliament ne ise phir bhi rakha, jaisa Verma report par hamari story batati hai.

## Separated husbands: gine jaate hain, par dikhte nahi

Ek chhota sa darwaza khula hai. BNS ki Section 67 kehti hai ki agar husband alag reh rahi wife ke saath bina consent sex kare, toh use 2 se 7 saal ki jail ho sakti hai, jo kisi bhi doosri aurat ke rape ki kam se kam 10 saal ki saza se kaafi kam hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. NCRB ka rape head Section 67 ko baaki rape sections ke saath ginta hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Lekin yeh cases aapko alag se nahi milenge. NCRB ki offender table "separated husbands" ko friends, online friends aur "shaadi ke bahane" wale live-in partners ke saath ek hi group mein rakhti hai: 2024 mein 13,879 cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Inmein husbands kitne the, table nahi batati. Jin 14% married survivors ne former husband ka naam liya, unse match karta koi police number bhi nahi hai.

## Har national rape figure par iska asar

Har headline rape number se 18 saal ya usse badi wives ke saath husbands ki zabardasti bahar reh jaati hai, jab tak couple alag na reh raha ho:

- **Count.** 2024 mein police ne 29,536 rape cases register kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Adult wife ke saath reh rahe kisi husband ka inmein ek bhi case nahi hai.
- **Rate.** NCRB cases ko saari auraton ki sankhya se divide karke rate nikaalta hai: har lakh auraton par 4.3 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Married auratein denominator mein toh hain, lekin jin mardon ka naam married survivors sabse zyada leti hain, woh numerator mein aa hi nahi sakte.
- **Known-offender share.** 2024 ke 96.8% cases mein accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh hisaab saath reh rahe husbands ko chhod kar lagaya gaya hai. Unhe ginein toh yeh share sirf badh hi sakta hai.
- **Trends aur state rankings.** Saalon ya states ke beech har comparison mein bhi yahi group gayab hai. Agar exception khatam hua toh registered rape shayad badhega, kyunki law badla, isliye nahi ki violence achanak badh gayi: wahi rule jo BNS ke pehle crime data par hamari explainer har nayi category par lagaati hai.

## Supreme Court ke saamne challenge

March 2022 mein Karnataka High Court ne kaha ki yeh exception har haal mein laagu nahi hota aur apni wife ke saath bina consent zabardasti sex karne wale husband par IPC ki Section 376 mein rape ka case chal sakta hai; July 2022 mein Supreme Court ne us faisle par rok laga di, aur ab usi husband ki appeal lead case hai [[indianexpress-marital-rape-final-hearing-2026]]. 11 May 2022 ko Delhi High Court ne RIT Foundation v. Union of India mein split verdict diya: Justice Rajiv Shakdher ne exception ko strike down kiya, Justice C. Hari Shankar ne use sahi thehraya [[scconline-rit-foundation-split-verdict-2022]].

Union government exception ke paksh mein hai. 3 October 2024 ko verify hue ek affidavit mein usne marital rape ko "more of a social issue rather than a legal issue" kaha, aur kaha ki ise rape banana "excessively harsh and therefore, disproportionate" ho sakta hai [[union-counter-affidavit-marital-rape-2024]].

9 September 2026 ko Chief Justice Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi aur Justice V. Mohana ki bench ne cases ko final hearing ke liye list kiya, yeh decide karne ke liye ki exception valid hai ya nahi, aur jab tak yeh law mein hai tab tak kya husband par case chal sakta hai [[livelaw-marital-rape-final-hearing-2026]]. 19 November 2026 tak koi faisla nahi aaya tha; bench ne kaha ki final hearing 9 ya 10 December 2026 ko, winter break se pehle, rakhi jaayegi [[lawbeat-marital-rape-hearing-2026]].

Tab tak bhi ek wife ke paas kuch raaste hain, haalaanki inmein se koi bhi statistics mein rape ke taur par nahi dikhega: cruelty ki complaint; Domestic Violence Act ke under protection order, kyunki yeh law sexual abuse ko bhi domestic violence maanta hai [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]; aur agar woh pregnant hai, toh rape survivor ke taur par 24 hafte tak abortion, bina FIR ke [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]], jaisa 2022 ke abortion faisle par hamari story batati hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

india-rape-count-twelve-year-trend.en:
Each year the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) publishes *Crime in India*, and each year one number leads the news: how many rape cases police registered. Lay twelve years of that number side by side and it draws a clear shape. Police registered 24,923 rape cases in 2012 [[ncrb-cii-2012-figures-at-a-glance]], 38,947 in 2016 [[ncrb-cii-2016-snapshots]] and 29,536 in 2024, the latest year published [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. It is tempting to read that as a crime that grew and is now shrinking. The shape is real. That reading is not.

| Year | Rape cases registered | What else was going on |
|---|---|---|
| 2012 | 24,923 | Last year under the old, narrow definition |
| 2013 | 33,707 | Wider legal definition from 3 February |
| 2016 | 38,947 | Highest count of 2012-2024 |
| 2020 | 28,046 | COVID-19 lockdown year; lowest count of 2013-2024 |
| 2024 | 29,536 | Latest year published |

## 2012 to 2013: a new law, a new count

After the 2012 Delhi gang rape case, the government set up a committee under Justice J.S. Verma in December 2012; it reported on 23 January 2013 [[thehindu-verma-2013]]. Parliament then passed the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013, deemed to be in force from 3 February 2013. It widened the legal meaning of rape beyond penile-vaginal intercourse to other forms of penetration, including with an object [[prs-cla-bill-2013-as-passed-ls]].

The same law changed two more things that move a count. It raised the age below which sex with a girl is rape, whatever she says, from 16 to 18 [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]]. And it made it a crime for police to refuse to record an FIR for rape, punishable with six months to two years in prison [[indiacode-cla-2013]]. In November 2013 the Supreme Court added that registering an FIR is mandatory when a complaint discloses a cognizable offence [[sc-lalita-kumari-2013]].

Registered rape rose to 33,707 in 2013 [[ncrb-cii-2013-figures-at-a-glance]], more than a third higher in a single year. Part of that jump was written into the law itself: the definition got wider, the age line moved, and turning a woman away at the station became an offence. A 2012 figure and a 2013 figure measure different things. Any chart that joins them with one smooth line hides a break.

## The 2016 peak

The count kept climbing: 36,735 in 2014 [[ncrb-cii-2014-figures-at-a-glance]], 34,651 in 2015 [[ncrb-cii-2015-figures-at-a-glance]] and 38,947 in 2016, the highest annual figure between 2012 and 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2016-snapshots]]. Then it fell to 32,559 in 2017 [[ncrb-cii-2018]], about a sixth lower in one year.

The count alone cannot tell you why it fell, and that is the lesson of the peak. Like every point on this line, it tells you how many complaints became FIRs under one legal heading in one year. It does not tell you how many women and girls were raped.

## Eight years of decline, on paper

After a small rise to 33,356 in 2018 [[ncrb-cii-2018]], the line drifts down: 32,032 in 2019 and 28,046 in 2020, the lowest count of 2013-2024 [[ncrb-cii-2021]]. 2020 was the COVID-19 lockdown year; fewer FIRs from a year of closed doors and stopped travel are not evidence of less violence. The count then reads 31,677 in 2021 [[ncrb-cii-2021]], 31,516 in 2022 [[ncrb-cii-2022]], 29,670 in 2023 [[ncrb-cii-2023]] and 29,536 in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Now look inside the column. In 2018, 9,433 of the 33,977 victims recorded under the rape head, or 27.8%, were girls under 18 [[ncrb-cii-2018]]. In 2024 just 792 of 29,742 were [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Child rape did not vanish. It is now filed almost entirely under the POCSO Act, which recorded 43,313 cases of penetrative sexual assault on girls in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Our data story on the POCSO column adds the two counts together.

Take the girls out and the decline disappears. Adult women recorded under the rape head numbered 24,544 in 2018 (33,977 minus 9,433) [[ncrb-cii-2018]] and 28,950 in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. On paper, rape fell. For adult women, the registered count rose.

> Since 2018, the whole fall in the rape count comes from girls' cases moving to another table. The number of adult women in it went up.

## What the line cannot tell you

NCRB itself warns against reading registration as crime. Its guidance says registered numbers can rise because of citizen-friendly policing, such as e-FIR facilities or women help desks [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. In December 2019 the Home Ministry sanctioned Rs 100 crore from the Nirbhaya Fund for exactly such help desks in police stations [[pib-mha-women-help-desks-2019]]. So in the same years, better policing could push the count up while filing changes pulled it down. The line shows only the net result.

The law kept moving too. Since July 2024, sex by deceit or a false promise of marriage has its own offence under Section 69 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, with 1,325 cases in its first six months [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Our guide to the new code explains why some of those complaints might once have been booked as rape.

And one line barely moved. Courts convicted in about 24% of rape trials completed in 2012 [[ncrb-cii-2012-figures-at-a-glance]] and in 24.4% of those completed in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Twelve years of new laws changed what gets counted far more than what gets punished.

None of these numbers is a count of rapes. In the national health survey NFHS-5 (2019-21), only 14% of women who had faced physical or sexual violence sought any help, and only 6% of those who did went to the police [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Our myth-buster on the police figure works through what that means. So when the next edition says rape "fell", ask three questions before you share it. Did the law or the filing rules change? Did reporting get easier or harder? Are child rapes filed under POCSO, and rapes that ended in murder, counted somewhere else? A falling number is a question, not good news.
india-rape-count-twelve-year-trend.hg:
Har saal National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) apni *Crime in India* report nikalta hai, aur har saal news mein sabse pehle ek hi number aata hai: police ne rape ke kitne cases register kiye. Barah saal ke yeh numbers ek saath rakhiye, toh ek clear shape banti hai. 2012 mein police ne rape ke 24,923 cases register kiye [[ncrb-cii-2012-figures-at-a-glance]], 2016 mein 38,947 [[ncrb-cii-2016-snapshots]] aur 2024 mein, jiska data sabse naya hai, 29,536 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Dekh kar lagta hai ki yeh crime pehle badha aur ab ghat raha hai. Shape sahi hai. Par yeh matlab nikalna galat hai.

| Saal | Registered rape cases | Us waqt aur kya chal raha tha |
|---|---|---|
| 2012 | 24,923 | Purani, chhoti definition ka aakhri saal |
| 2013 | 33,707 | 3 February se rape ki badi definition |
| 2016 | 38,947 | 2012-2024 ke beech sabse zyada |
| 2020 | 28,046 | COVID-19 lockdown; 2013-2024 ke beech sabse kam |
| 2024 | 29,536 | Sabse naya published saal |

## 2012 se 2013: naya law, nayi ginti

2012 ke Delhi gang rape case ke baad sarkar ne December 2012 mein Justice J.S. Verma ki leadership mein ek committee banayi, jisne 23 January 2013 ko apni report de di [[thehindu-verma-2013]]. Uske baad Parliament ne Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013 pass kiya, jo 3 February 2013 se laagu maana gaya. Pehle law mein rape ka matlab sirf penile-vaginal intercourse tha. Naye law mein doosri tarah ka penetration bhi rape maana gaya, kisi object se kiya gaya penetration bhi [[prs-cla-bill-2013-as-passed-ls]].

Isi law ne do aur cheezein badlin, jinka seedha asar count par padta hai. Pehli baat umar ki hai. Ab 18 saal se kam umar ki ladki ke saath sex rape hai, chahe woh haan kahe ya na. Pehle yeh umar 16 saal thi [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]]. Doosri baat police station ki hai. Rape ki FIR likhne se mana karna police ke liye crime ban gaya, jiski saza chhe mahine se do saal tak ki jail hai [[indiacode-cla-2013]]. November 2013 mein Supreme Court ne bhi clear kaha ki complaint mein agar cognizable offence ki baat hai, toh FIR darj karna zaroori hai [[sc-lalita-kumari-2013]].

2013 mein registered rape cases badh kar 33,707 ho gaye [[ncrb-cii-2013-figures-at-a-glance]]. Ek hi saal mein ek-tihai se zyada ka jump. Is jump ka ek hissa toh law mein hi likha tha: definition badi hui, age ki line badli, aur police station se aurat ko lautana crime ban gaya. Yaani 2012 ka number aur 2013 ka number alag-alag cheezein ginte hain. Jo chart in dono ko ek smooth line se jodta hai, woh is break ko chhupa leta hai.

## 2016 ka peak

Iske baad bhi count badhta raha: 2014 mein 36,735 [[ncrb-cii-2014-figures-at-a-glance]], 2015 mein 34,651 [[ncrb-cii-2015-figures-at-a-glance]] aur 2016 mein 38,947, jo 2012 se 2024 ke beech kisi bhi saal ka sabse bada figure hai [[ncrb-cii-2016-snapshots]]. Phir 2017 mein count gir kar 32,559 par aa gaya [[ncrb-cii-2018]], yaani ek saal mein lagbhag chhatha hissa kam.

Sirf count dekh kar yeh pata nahi chalta ki yeh girawat kyun aayi, aur yahi is peak ka lesson hai. Is line ka har point bas itna batata hai ki us saal kitni complaints ek legal head ke andar FIR baneen. Yeh nahi batata ki kitni women aur girls ke saath rape hua.

## Aath saal ki girawat, sirf kaagaz par

2018 mein count thoda badh kar 33,356 hua [[ncrb-cii-2018]], phir line dheere-dheere neeche aati hai: 2019 mein 32,032 aur 2020 mein 28,046, jo 2013-2024 ke beech sabse kam count hai [[ncrb-cii-2021]]. 2020 COVID-19 lockdown ka saal tha. Jis saal darwaze band the aur aana-jaana ruka hua tha, us saal kam FIR ka matlab kam violence nahi hai. Uske baad count 2021 mein 31,677 [[ncrb-cii-2021]], 2022 mein 31,516 [[ncrb-cii-2022]], 2023 mein 29,670 [[ncrb-cii-2023]] aur 2024 mein 29,536 raha [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Ab is column ke andar jhaankiye. 2018 mein rape head ke 33,977 victims mein se 9,433, yaani 27.8%, 18 saal se kam umar ki ladkiyan thin [[ncrb-cii-2018]]. 2024 mein 29,742 mein se sirf 792 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Bachchiyon ke saath rape khatam nahi hua. Ab aise cases lagbhag poore ke poore POCSO Act mein file hote hain, jismein 2024 mein ladkiyon par penetrative sexual assault ke 43,313 cases darj hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. POCSO column par hamari data story dono counts ko jod kar dikhati hai.

Ab ladkiyon ko hata kar dekhiye, girawat gayab ho jaati hai. Rape head mein adult women 2018 mein 24,544 thin (33,977 mein se 9,433 ghata kar) [[ncrb-cii-2018]] aur 2024 mein 28,950 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Kaagaz par rape ghata. Adult women ka registered count badh gaya.

> 2018 ke baad rape count mein jo poori girawat dikhti hai, woh ladkiyon ke cases doosri table mein jaane se aayi hai. Adult women ki ginti toh badhi hai.

## Yeh line kya nahi bata sakti

NCRB khud warn karta hai ki registration ko crime mat samjhiye. Uski guidance kehti hai ki registered numbers citizen-friendly policing se bhi badh sakte hain, jaise e-FIR facility ya women help desks [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. December 2019 mein Home Ministry ne Nirbhaya Fund se police stations mein bilkul aise hi women help desks ke liye Rs 100 crore sanction kiye [[pib-mha-women-help-desks-2019]]. Yaani inhi saalon mein behtar policing count ko upar dhakel sakti thi, aur usi waqt case file karne ka badla hua tareeka use neeche kheench raha tha. Line bas dono ka final result dikhati hai.

Law bhi badalta raha. July 2024 se Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ke Section 69 mein dhokhe se ya shaadi ka jhootha vaada karke banaye gaye sexual relation ka alag offence hai, jismein pehle chhe mahine mein 1,325 cases darj hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Naye code par hamari guide samjhati hai ki inmein se kuch complaints pehle shayad rape ke head mein darj hoti.

Aur ek line toh lagbhag hili hi nahi. 2012 mein jin rape cases ka trial poora hua, unmein se lagbhag 24% mein conviction hua [[ncrb-cii-2012-figures-at-a-glance]]. 2024 mein yeh 24.4% tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Barah saal ke naye laws ne yeh zyada badla ki kya gina jaata hai, yeh bahut kam ki saza kise milti hai.

Inmein se koi bhi number rapes ki asli ginti nahi hai. National health survey NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali sirf 14% women ne kisi se bhi madad maangi, aur madad maangne walon mein se sirf 6% police ke paas gayin [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Police figure wale myth par hamara article samjhata hai ki iska matlab kya hai. Isliye agli baar jab report kahe ki rape "ghat gaye", toh share karne se pehle teen sawaal poochiye. Kya law ya case file karne ke rules badle? Kya report karna aasaan hua ya mushkil? Kya POCSO mein file hue child rape cases, aur woh rapes jinke baad murder hua, kahin aur toh nahi gine gaye? Girta hua number ek sawaal hai, achhi khabar nahi.

india-real-rape-count-includes-pocso.en:
The rape figure in NCRB's *Crime in India 2024* is 29,536 cases, involving 29,742 women and girls [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. It is the number that leads the news, that politicians quote and that family WhatsApp groups forward. It also leaves out most of the rape cases police registered that year, because the rape of girls under 18 sits almost entirely in a different table.

## Two tables, one crime

NCRB records the rape of women and girls in two main places. The first is the "rape" head, filled by cases under the rape sections of the old Indian Penal Code and the new Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). The second is the POCSO table. The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, in force since 14 November 2012, covers everyone under 18, girls and boys alike [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Its Sections 4 and 6 deal with penetrative and aggravated penetrative sexual assault: in plain words, the rape of a child.

When an FIR about a girl invokes POCSO Sections 4 or 6, alone or read with the rape sections, NCRB counts it in the POCSO table [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. And because NCRB counts each FIR only once, under its most serious offence, no case appears in both [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The tables do not overlap. They are two halves of one count.

Both halves sit in NCRB's chapter on crimes against women. NCRB's own summary for 2024 puts POCSO cases with girl victims at 15.4% of all crimes against women. Rape's 29,536 cases work out to 6.7% [[ncrb-cii-2024-snapshots]].

## 792 versus 43,313

In 2024 the rape table recorded 792 victims under 18, out of 29,742 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The POCSO table recorded 43,313 cases of penetrative or aggravated penetrative sexual assault on girls, involving 43,675 girls [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The child-rape column for girls alone was bigger than the entire rape head.

The ages make it harder to look away. Of the 44,567 children recorded as victims of penetrative sexual assault under POCSO that year, 831 were under six and 3,438 were between six and 12 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. None of them is in the number most people call "India's rape count".

Boys are missing from it too. POCSO recorded 892 boys as victims of penetrative sexual assault in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], and they could never appear in the rape table, because Section 63 of the BNS defines rape as an act by a man against a woman [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Our story on boys in POCSO data explains why even 892 is likely a fraction.

This is not a one-year quirk. In 2023, police registered 40,046 child-rape cases with girl victims under POCSO, and 29,670 cases under the rape head [[ncrb-cii-2023]].

## Why the child share "fell" from 27.8% to 2.7%

It was not always this lopsided. In 2018, 9,433 of the 33,977 victims in the rape table, or 27.8%, were girls under 18 [[ncrb-cii-2018]]. The share dropped to 9.5% in 2021 [[ncrb-cii-2021]], 3.2% in 2022 [[ncrb-cii-2022]] and 2.7% in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Child rape did not fall by nine-tenths in six years. The POCSO count for girls went up, not down: from 40,046 cases in 2023 [[ncrb-cii-2023]] to 43,313 in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. What changed is where police file the cases. So the 792 is not the number of girls raped in 2024. It is the number whose cases happened to be filed under the rape sections.

The filing habit also bends state rankings. Tamil Nadu had one of India's lowest rape rates in 2024, 1.1 per lakh women, from 419 cases, and every one of those cases had an adult victim [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The same year it registered 6,969 POCSO cases, a rate of 33.7 per lakh children, among the highest of any state [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. On the rape table alone, Tamil Nadu looks like one of the safest places in India for women and girls. Its girls are simply in the other table.

## The number to quote from now on

Add the two tables and the 2024 picture changes. Police registered 29,536 rape cases and 43,313 POCSO penetrative-assault cases with girl victims: 72,849 cases of rape or penetrative sexual assault against women and girls [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The headline figure is about two-fifths of that.

> India's honest rape figure for 2024 is not 29,536. It is at least 72,849.

Even that is a floor. It leaves out the 892 boys. It leaves out the 266 cases of murder with rape or gang rape, which NCRB files under a separate head [[ncrb-cii-2024]]; our explainer on the principal offence rule shows how they drop out. And as our myth-buster on the police figure shows, it leaves out every assault that never reached a police station.

So the next time you read "29,536 rapes in 2024", correct it to "29,536 cases filed under the rape sections". If you need one figure for rape and penetrative sexual assault on women and girls that year, use 72,849, and call it what it is: a minimum.
india-real-rape-count-includes-pocso.hg:
NCRB ki *Crime in India 2024* report mein rape ka figure hai: 29,536 cases, jinmein 29,742 women aur girls darj thin [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. News mein yahi number sabse aage rehta hai, neta yahi number bolte hain, family WhatsApp groups yahi number forward karte hain. Par us saal police ne rape ke jitne cases register kiye, unmein se zyadatar is number mein hain hi nahi. Wajah yeh hai ki 18 saal se kam umar ki ladkiyon ke rape ke cases lagbhag poore ke poore ek doosri table mein baithe hain.

## Do tables, ek hi crime

NCRB women aur girls ke rape ko do mukhya jagah record karta hai. Pehli jagah hai "rape" head, jismein purane Indian Penal Code aur naye Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke rape sections wale cases aate hain. Doosri jagah hai POCSO table. Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act 14 November 2012 se laagu hai, aur 18 saal se kam umar ke har bachche ko cover karta hai, ladki ho ya ladka [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Iske Section 4 aur 6 penetrative aur aggravated penetrative sexual assault ki baat karte hain. Seedhe shabdon mein, bachche ka rape.

Jab kisi ladki wali FIR mein POCSO Section 4 ya 6 lagta hai, akele ya rape sections ke saath, toh NCRB use POCSO table mein ginta hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Aur kyunki NCRB har FIR ko sirf ek baar ginta hai, uske sabse serious offence ke naam par, koi bhi case dono tables mein nahi aata [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Dono tables overlap nahi karti. Yeh ek hi count ke do hisse hain.

Dono hisse NCRB ke usi chapter mein hain jo crimes against women ka hai. 2024 ki apni summary mein NCRB batata hai ki women ke khilaaf kul crimes mein POCSO ke girl victims wale cases 15.4% the. Rape ke 29,536 cases hisaab lagane par sirf 6.7% baithte hain [[ncrb-cii-2024-snapshots]].

## 792 versus 43,313

2024 mein rape table ke 29,742 victims mein se 18 saal se kam umar ki sirf 792 ladkiyan thin [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Usi saal POCSO table mein ladkiyon par penetrative ya aggravated penetrative sexual assault ke 43,313 cases darj hue, jinmein 43,675 ladkiyan thin [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yaani sirf ladkiyon ka child rape column hi poore rape head se bada tha.

Umar dekhenge toh nazar hatana aur mushkil ho jaayega. Us saal POCSO mein penetrative sexual assault ke 44,567 child victims darj hue. Inmein 831 bachche chhe saal se chhote the aur 3,438 chhe se 12 saal ke [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Inmein se koi bhi us number mein nahi hai jise zyadatar log "India ka rape count" kehte hain.

Ladke bhi is count se gayab hain. 2024 mein POCSO mein 892 ladke penetrative sexual assault ke victims darj hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh rape table mein kabhi aa hi nahi sakte, kyunki BNS ka Section 63 rape ko ek aadmi dwara ek aurat ke khilaaf kiya gaya act maanta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. POCSO data mein ladkon par hamari story batati hai ki 892 bhi shayad asli sankhya ka chhota sa hissa hai.

Yeh kisi ek saal ka ittefaq nahi hai. 2023 mein bhi police ne POCSO mein girl victims wale child rape ke 40,046 cases register kiye the, aur rape head mein 29,670 [[ncrb-cii-2023]].

## Child share 27.8% se 2.7% par kyun "gira"

Hamesha aisa nahi tha. 2018 mein rape table ke 33,977 victims mein se 9,433, yaani 27.8%, 18 saal se kam ki ladkiyan thin [[ncrb-cii-2018]]. Phir yeh share 2021 mein 9.5% [[ncrb-cii-2021]], 2022 mein 3.2% [[ncrb-cii-2022]] aur 2024 mein 2.7% par aa gaya [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Chhe saal mein child rape das mein se nau hisse kam nahi ho gaya. Ladkiyon ka POCSO count ghata nahi, badha: 2023 mein 40,046 cases [[ncrb-cii-2023]] aur 2024 mein 43,313 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Badla sirf yeh ki police cases kis head mein file karti hai. Isliye 792 ka matlab yeh nahi ki 2024 mein itni hi ladkiyon ka rape hua. Yeh bas un ladkiyon ki ginti hai jinke cases rape sections mein file ho gaye.

Case file karne ki yeh aadat states ki ranking bhi bigaad deti hai. 2024 mein Tamil Nadu ka rape rate desh ke sabse kam rates mein tha: har ek lakh women par 1.1, kul 419 cases, aur yeh saare cases adult women ke the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Usi saal Tamil Nadu mein POCSO ke 6,969 cases register hue, yaani har ek lakh bachchon par 33.7, jo states mein sabse oonche rates mein se ek hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Sirf rape table dekhiye, toh Tamil Nadu women aur girls ke liye desh ki sabse safe jagahon mein se lagta hai. Asal mein wahan ki ladkiyan bas doosri table mein darj hain.

## Ab se yahi number quote kijiye

Dono tables jodiye, toh 2024 ki picture badal jaati hai. Police ne rape ke 29,536 cases aur girl victims wale POCSO penetrative assault ke 43,313 cases register kiye: yaani women aur girls ke saath rape ya penetrative sexual assault ke kul 72,849 cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Headline wala figure iska lagbhag paanch mein se do hissa hi hai.

> 2024 ke liye India ka imaandaar rape figure 29,536 nahi hai. Yeh kam se kam 72,849 hai.

Aur yeh bhi sirf minimum hai. Ismein 892 ladke nahi hain. Ismein murder with rape ya gang rape ke 266 cases bhi nahi hain, jinhe NCRB ek alag head mein rakhta hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh cases kaise bahar ho jaate hain, yeh principal offence rule par hamara explainer samjhata hai. Aur police figure wale myth par hamara article dikhata hai ki ismein woh har assault bhi nahi hai jo kabhi police station tak pahuncha hi nahi.

Isliye agli baar jab aap padhein "2024 mein 29,536 rapes", toh use theek karke kahiye: "rape sections mein file hue 29,536 cases". Agar us saal women aur girls ke rape aur penetrative sexual assault ka ek figure chahiye, toh 72,849 boliye, aur saath mein yeh bhi kahiye ki yeh minimum hai.

kerala-high-reporting-not-high-danger.en:
Rank India's states by the rate of registered child sexual abuse and Kerala comes first. Rank them by sexual harassment cases at offices, or on buses and trains, and Kerala comes first again. Its police also registered 496 of the 616 criminal cases filed in all of India in 2024 under the Domestic Violence Act [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Read carelessly, the tables make Kerala look like one of India's most dangerous places for women and children. Read alongside the surveys, they look more like the record of a state where complaints get written down.

## Top of the wrong tables?

Kerala's 2024 police record, against the national picture [[ncrb-cii-2024]]:

| Measure, 2024 | Kerala | India |
|---|---|---|
| POCSO cases per lakh children | 48.0 | 15.6 |
| Sexual harassment cases at office premises | 89 | 388 |
| Sexual harassment cases in public transport | 100 | 459 |
| Criminal cases under the Domestic Violence Act | 496 | 616 |
| Rape cases per lakh women | 5.0 | 4.3 |
| Crimes against women per lakh women | 80.5 | 64.6 |

Not every Kerala number stands out. Its registered rape rate sits just above the national figure and far below Rajasthan's 12.2 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Kerala leads where registration depends most on a victim choosing to complain and an officer choosing to record: a parent going to the police about a child, a woman reporting a colleague or a fellow passenger, a wife going back to the police when a court order is broken.

## 48.0 per lakh children

By count, Kerala registered 4,513 POCSO cases in 2024, fifth in India behind much bigger states such as Maharashtra (9,432) and Uttar Pradesh (8,087) [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. By rate it is first among states, at 48.0 cases per lakh children, ahead of Sikkim (36.7), Mizoram (36.4) and Tamil Nadu (33.7), and about three times the national 15.6 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

A POCSO case needs a chain: a child who tells, an adult who reports, an officer who writes the FIR. The law makes the middle link a duty. Anyone who knows of child sexual abuse must report it, and failing to do so is punishable with up to six months in prison or a fine [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. A high rate can mean the chain holds more often. On its own, it cannot show how much abuse happens. When the government asked children directly in its 2007 Study on Child Abuse, a non-representative sample taken before POCSO existed, 72.1% of those who had been sexually assaulted had told no one, and only 3.4% had gone to the police [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

## Harassment at work and on the bus

Police across India registered 15,609 sexual harassment cases in 2024; 388 were at office premises and 459 in public transport [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Kerala's 89 office cases and 100 transport cases were the most of any state, more than a fifth of each national total. Rajasthan, Odisha and West Bengal recorded none at office premises; Delhi recorded 18 in public transport [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Imagine two women sexually harassed on two crowded buses, one in Thiruvananthapuram and one in Delhi. What separates them in the data is not what happened on the bus. It is what happened next: whether she expected a complaint to be taken seriously, and whether anyone wrote it down.

Kerala is not a model in everything. The Hema Committee's report on sexual harassment in the Malayalam film industry reached the state government in December 2019 and was made public only on 19 August 2024 [[nie-hema-report-release-2024]]. In September 2024 the Kerala High Court asked why the government had been "inactive or silent" since 31 December 2019 [[livelaw-kerala-hc-hema-sit-2024]]. A public willing to complain does not guarantee a government willing to act.

## What the surveys say
