Police records count complaints; household surveys ask women directly. In NFHS-5 (2019-21), 9.8% of ever-married women in Kerala reported physical or sexual violence by a husband, against 29.2% nationally and 44.4% in neighbouring Karnataka [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. If Kerala's high count of domestic-violence cases reflected unusually violent homes, the survey should have shown it. It showed the opposite.

The provisional NFHS-6 fact sheets (2023-24) complicate the picture. Kerala's figure rose to 17.7%, while Karnataka's fell to 14.1% and India's to 22.3% [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]]. Experts quoted by Deccan Herald doubted that such falls are real, saying women may not disclose abuse to a surveyor in front of family members [[deccanherald-nfhs6-gbv-2026]]. The same logic can run the other way. If silence pulls a survey number down, a greater willingness to speak can push it up. The fact sheets cannot tell more violence from more telling.

## A reporting culture, and what it takes

NCRB's own guidance says "rise in crime" and "increase in registration of crime by police" are two different things, and that numbers can rise after citizen-centric steps such as e-FIR facilities or women's help desks [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]]. Research points the same way. After Indian states reserved a third of local council seats for women, documented crimes against women rose 46% and recorded rapes 23%, driven mainly by greater reporting rather than more crime [[aej-iyer-political-voice-2012]].

Reporting is also built by people who refuse to let a complaint die. The Women in Cinema Collective went to the Kerala High Court in 2018, arguing that the actors' association was bound to have a complaints committee and had none [[livelaw-kwc-wcc-pil-2022]]; in March 2022 the court ruled that every film production unit with more than 10 workers must have one [[kerala-hc-wcc-judgment-2022]]. The Domestic Violence Act is mostly civil, but breaking a magistrate's protection order is a crime, punishable with up to a year in prison, a fine of up to Rs 20,000, or both [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Kerala's 496 cases suggest that women there take broken orders back to the police, and that police register them.

When Kerala tops a table, ask what its police and courts did that others did not. When your own state sits near the bottom, ask who is not being heard.
kerala-high-reporting-not-high-danger.hg:
India ke states ko darj child sexual abuse ke rate ke hisaab se rank kijiye, toh Kerala pehle number par aata hai. Offices mein, ya bus aur train mein sexual harassment ke cases ke hisaab se rank kijiye, toh bhi Kerala pehle number par. 2024 mein Domestic Violence Act ke tahat poore India mein darj 616 criminal cases mein se 496 bhi Kerala ki police ne darj kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Laaparwaahi se padhein, toh yeh tables Kerala ko aurton aur bachchon ke liye India ki sabse khatarnaak jagahon mein se ek dikhaati hain. Surveys ke saath padhein, toh yeh ek aise state ka record zyada lagti hain jahan complaints likhi jaati hain.

## Galat tables mein sabse upar?

2024 mein Kerala ka police record, national tasveer ke saamne [[ncrb-cii-2024]]:

| Paimaana, 2024 | Kerala | India |
|---|---|---|
| Har lakh bachchon par POCSO case | 48.0 | 15.6 |
| Office premises par sexual harassment ke case | 89 | 388 |
| Public transport mein sexual harassment ke case | 100 | 459 |
| Domestic Violence Act ke tahat criminal case | 496 | 616 |
| Har lakh aurton par rape case | 5.0 | 4.3 |
| Har lakh aurton par aurton ke khilaaf crime | 80.5 | 64.6 |

Kerala ka har number alag se nahi chamakta. Uska darj rape rate national figure se bas thoda upar hai, aur Rajasthan ke 12.2 se kaafi neeche [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Kerala wahan aage hai jahan case darj hona sabse zyada is par tikta hai ki victim complaint karne ka faisla kare aur officer use likhne ka: koi maa-baap bachche ke liye police ke paas jaaye, koi aurat kisi colleague ya saath safar kar rahe passenger ki report kare, ya koi patni court ka order tootne par wapas police ke paas jaaye.

## Har lakh bachchon par 48.0

Count ke hisaab se Kerala ne 2024 mein 4,513 POCSO case darj kiye, aur India mein paanchve number par raha, Maharashtra (9,432) aur Uttar Pradesh (8,087) jaise kahin bade states ke peeche [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Rate ke hisaab se woh states mein pehle number par hai: har lakh bachchon par 48.0 case, Sikkim (36.7), Mizoram (36.4) aur Tamil Nadu (33.7) se aage, aur national rate 15.6 ka qareeb teen guna [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Ek POCSO case ke liye ek chain chahiye: bachcha jo bataye, adult jo report kare, aur officer jo FIR likhe. Law beech wali kadi ko zimmedaari bana deta hai. Jo bhi child sexual abuse ke baare mein jaanta hai, use report karna hi hoga, aur report na karne par chhe mahine tak ki jail ya fine ho sakta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Bade rate ka matlab yeh ho sakta hai ki yeh chain zyada baar tikti hai. Akela yeh rate nahi dikha sakta ki abuse kitna hota hai. Jab sarkar ne 2007 ki Study on Child Abuse mein seedhe bachchon se poochha tha (sample non-representative tha, aur tab POCSO bana bhi nahi tha), toh sexual assault jhel chuke bachchon mein se 72.1% ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha, aur sirf 3.4% police ke paas gaye the [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

## Kaam par aur bus mein harassment

2024 mein poore India mein police ne sexual harassment ke 15,609 case darj kiye; inmein se 388 office premises par the aur 459 public transport mein [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Kerala ke 89 office cases aur 100 transport cases kisi bhi state mein sabse zyada the, dono national totals ke paanchve hisse se bhi zyada. Rajasthan, Odisha aur West Bengal mein office premises par ek bhi case darj nahi hua; Delhi mein public transport ke 18 case darj hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Sochiye, do bhari hui buses mein do aurton ke saath sexual harassment hua, ek Thiruvananthapuram mein aur ek Delhi mein. Data mein un dono ke beech ka farq bus mein hui ghatna nahi hai. Farq yeh hai ki uske baad kya hua: kya use bharosa tha ki complaint ko seriously liya jaayega, aur kya kisi ne use likha.

Kerala har cheez mein model nahi hai. Malayalam film industry mein sexual harassment par Hema Committee ki report December 2019 mein state government ke paas pahunch gayi thi, lekin public sirf 19 August 2024 ko hui [[nie-hema-report-release-2024]]. September 2024 mein Kerala High Court ne poochha ki sarkar 31 December 2019 se "inactive or silent", yaani chup aur nishkriya, kyun thi [[livelaw-kerala-hc-hema-sit-2024]]. Complaint karne ko taiyaar public ka matlab yeh nahi ki sarkar bhi action lene ko taiyaar hogi.

## Surveys kya kehte hain

Police records complaints ginte hain; household surveys seedhe aurton se poochhte hain. NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein Kerala ki 9.8% shaadishuda aurton ne pati ki taraf se physical ya sexual violence report ki, jabki poore desh mein yeh 29.2% aur padosi Karnataka mein 44.4% tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Agar Kerala ke domestic violence ke zyada case is wajah se hote ki wahan ke ghar unusually violent hain, toh survey mein yeh dikhna chahiye tha. Survey ne ulta dikhaya.

NFHS-6 (2023-24) ki provisional fact sheets tasveer ko uljha deti hain. Kerala ka figure badhkar 17.7% ho gaya, jabki Karnataka ka girkar 14.1% aur India ka 22.3% ho gaya [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]]. Deccan Herald mein quote kiye gaye experts ne is baat par shak jataya ki aisi giravat asli hai, kyunki aurtein parivaar ke saamne surveyor ko abuse ke baare mein shayad na batayein [[deccanherald-nfhs6-gbv-2026]]. Yahi tark ulti disha mein bhi chal sakta hai. Agar chuppi survey ke number ko neeche kheench sakti hai, toh bolne ki zyada himmat use upar bhi le ja sakti hai. Fact sheets zyada violence aur zyada batane mein farq nahi kar sakti.

## Reporting culture, aur uske liye kya chahiye

NCRB ki apni guidance kehti hai ki "rise in crime" aur "increase in registration of crime by police" do alag cheezein hain, aur e-FIR facility ya women's help desk jaise citizen-centric kadamon ke baad numbers badh sakte hain [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]]. Research bhi isi taraf ishaara karti hai. Jab Indian states ne local councils ki ek-tihaai seats aurton ke liye reserve ki, toh aurton ke khilaaf darj crimes 46% aur darj rape 23% badhe, aur iski mukhya wajah zyada reporting thi, zyada crime nahi [[aej-iyer-political-voice-2012]].

Reporting un logon se bhi banti hai jo kisi complaint ko dabne nahi dete. Women in Cinema Collective 2018 mein Kerala High Court gaya, is daleel ke saath ki actors' association ke liye complaints committee banana zaroori tha aur uske paas koi committee nahi thi [[livelaw-kwc-wcc-pil-2022]]; March 2022 mein court ne faisla diya ki 10 se zyada workers wali har film production unit mein aisi committee honi chahiye [[kerala-hc-wcc-judgment-2022]]. Domestic Violence Act zyadatar civil law hai, lekin magistrate ka protection order todna crime hai, jiski saza ek saal tak ki jail, Rs 20,000 tak ka fine, ya dono hai [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Kerala ke 496 case ishaara karte hain ki wahan aurtein toote hue orders ko lekar wapas police ke paas jaati hain, aur police unhe darj karti hai.

Jab Kerala kisi table mein sabse upar ho, toh poochhiye ki uski police aur courts ne aisa kya kiya jo doosron ne nahi kiya. Jab aapka apna state sabse neeche ke aas-paas ho, toh poochhiye ki kiski baat suni nahi ja rahi.

kolkata-hyderabad-rape-registration-puzz.en:
In 2024, NCRB's table for India's 19 largest cities recorded 12 rape cases in Kolkata, a rate of 0.2 per lakh women, the lowest of all 19 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Hyderabad recorded 358, more than three times its count two years earlier. Read as a safety ranking, one city looks like a haven and the other like a city in crisis. Read as what they are, counts of complaints police registered as rape, they raise questions about how rape gets counted. This investigation puts those questions on record and shows how to spot a number too good, or too sudden, to trust.

## Kolkata's improbable calm

Kolkata's rape count has barely moved: 11 cases in 2022, 10 in 2023 and 12 in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2022]] [[ncrb-cii-2023]] [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The next-lowest city, Chennai, recorded 44 in 2024. Jaipur, whose female population in NCRB's table is a fraction of Kolkata's, recorded 497 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Kolkata's own row is where the calm looks strange. The same 2024 tables show 1,958 crimes against women in the city and 194 cases under the POCSO Act with girl victims [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Nationally, rape made up 6.7% of registered crimes against women, and POCSO cases with girl victims outnumbered rape cases by a little over two to one [[ncrb-cii-2024-snapshots]]. In Kolkata, rape was fewer than one in every 100 crimes against women, and POCSO cases outnumbered rape cases by about 16 to one.

Its overall rate of registered crime against women, 28.8 per lakh women, is also the second-lowest of the 19 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Its rape figure is in a category of its own.

## Hyderabad's tripling

Hyderabad moved the other way: 104 registered rape cases in 2022, 173 in 2023 and 358 in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2022]] [[ncrb-cii-2023]] [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. By 2024 it had the fourth-highest count of the 19 cities, behind Delhi (1,058), Jaipur (497) and Mumbai (411). The 19 cities together went from 3,633 rape cases to 3,886 over those two years, so Hyderabad's increase alone roughly equalled the net rise for all 19 combined [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

The city registered 3,255 crimes against women in 2024, and Telangana, its state, had the second-highest rate of registered crime against women of any state or union territory, 128.6 per lakh women, behind only Delhi [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

A city's population does not triple in two years. Something changed: the amount of violence, women's willingness to walk into a police station, police willingness to write complaints down, or the section they were written under. The numbers cannot say which.

## Classification, registration or crime?

Three explanations are possible, and they can overlap.

**Crime.** Violence may truly be rising in one city and rare in the other. Only a survey asking women in each city directly could test this.

**Registration.** A complaint becomes a statistic only when police register it. The Supreme Court held in 2013 that registering an FIR is mandatory when a complaint discloses a cognizable offence [[sc-lalita-kumari-2013]]. Under Section 199 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, a public servant who fails to record information about rape faces six months to two years in prison [[indiacode-bns-2023]], and rape falls outside the 14-day preliminary enquiry police may hold for some lesser offences [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. On paper, there is no lawful way to keep a rape complaint off the books. (This is general information, not legal advice.) NCRB itself says a rise in registration is not a rise in crime, and can follow steps such as e-FIR facilities or women's help desks [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]].

**Classification.** The same incident can be filed under different sections. Survivors under 18 are mostly counted under POCSO, not rape: only 784 of India's 29,536 rape cases in 2024 involved girls [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Each FIR is counted once, under its most serious offence. States also split cases differently between rape and attempt to rape. West Bengal registered 809 attempts to rape against 1,118 rapes in 2024, while India as a whole registered 2,561 attempts against 29,536 rapes [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

One more clue points to the front door rather than the back. Police in Kolkata charge-sheeted 98.5% of the crime-against-women cases they disposed of in 2024, the highest rate of the 19 cities [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Nearly every case that enters Kolkata's books goes to court. The question is what enters them, and under which section.

## Questions for the police

NCRB only compiles the figures that state police send it, and says it is not responsible for their authenticity [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. So the answers sit with the two cities' police. We put these questions on record:

- How many complaints of sexual violence by adult women did each force receive in 2022, 2023 and 2024, and under which sections were they registered: rape, attempt to rape, assault on a woman's modesty, or something else?
- Does NCRB's Kolkata figure cover only the area policed by Kolkata Police, while the population used for the rate covers a wider urban area? We could not confirm this either way.
- How many rape complaints were received but never registered as FIRs, and why?
- In Hyderabad, what changed after 2022: help desks, e-FIRs, an instruction to register every complaint, or more violence?

If Hyderabad's rise reflects women being heard, it should be explained and copied. If Kolkata's flat line reflects women being turned away or reclassified, it should be fixed.

## How to spot a suspicious number

Five checks catch most traps:

1. **Compare rates, not counts, and only within the same table.** NCRB calculates city rates on the 2011 Census population and says city and state rates are not comparable [[ncrb-cii-2024]].
2. **Read the neighbours.** A rape count that is a sliver of a city's crimes against women, or of its POCSO cases, is a flag.
3. **Watch the trend.** A number that triples in two years, or sits at a dozen in a city of millions, needs an explanation before it needs a headline.
4. **Ask what changed in policing** that year: a new law, a help desk, an online complaint system.
5. **Remember NCRB's own warning:** more crime registered in a city is "not an indicator of its being comparatively unsafe" [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]]. The reverse is just as true.

Kolkata's 12 and Hyderabad's 358 are not safety ratings. They are records of what reached the books. Until the police explain the gap, treat both as questions.
kolkata-hyderabad-rape-registration-puzz.hg:
2024 mein India ke 19 sabse bade shehron wali NCRB table ne Kolkata mein sirf 12 rape cases record kiye: har lakh auraton par 0.2, yaani 19 shehron mein sabse kam [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Hyderabad mein 358 cases record hue, jo do saal pehle ki ginti se teen guna se bhi zyada hai. Safety ranking ki tarah padhein toh ek shehar jannat lagta hai aur doosra crisis mein. Lekin yeh numbers asal mein hain kya? Woh complaints jinhe police ne rape ke roop mein register kiya. Is nazar se padhein toh yeh sawaal uthate hain ki rape ki ginti hoti kaise hai. Yeh investigation un sawaalon ko record par rakhti hai, aur sikhaati hai ki jo number bahut achha, ya bahut achanak lage, use kaise pehchaanein.

## Kolkata ki yakeen na aane wali shanti

Kolkata ki rape ginti mushkil se hili hai: 2022 mein 11 cases, 2023 mein 10 aur 2024 mein 12 [[ncrb-cii-2022]] [[ncrb-cii-2023]] [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Usse theek upar wale shehar Chennai mein 2024 mein 44 cases the. Aur Jaipur, jiski female population NCRB ki table mein Kolkata ke ek chhote se hisse jitni hai, wahan 497 cases record hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Kolkata ki apni row dekhiye, toh yeh shanti ajeeb lagne lagti hai. 2024 ki unhi tables mein shehar ke 1,958 crimes against women hain, aur girl victims wale 194 POCSO cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Poore desh mein registered crimes against women mein rape ka hissa 6.7% tha, aur girl victims wale POCSO cases rape cases se do guna se thode zyada the [[ncrb-cii-2024-snapshots]]. Kolkata mein har 100 crimes against women mein ek se bhi kam rape tha, aur POCSO cases rape cases se lagbhag 16 guna the.

Shehar ka overall crime against women rate bhi, 28.8 per lakh women, 19 shehron mein doosra sabse kam hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Lekin uska rape figure bilkul alag hi category mein hai.

## Hyderabad ki teen guna chhalaang

Hyderabad ulti disha mein gaya: 2022 mein 104 registered rape cases, 2023 mein 173 aur 2024 mein 358 [[ncrb-cii-2022]] [[ncrb-cii-2023]] [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. 2024 tak 19 shehron mein uski ginti chauthe number par thi, Delhi (1,058), Jaipur (497) aur Mumbai (411) ke baad. Unhi do saalon mein 19 shehron ki kul ginti 3,633 se 3,886 hui, yaani akele Hyderabad ki badhotri lagbhag utni hi thi jitni sabhi 19 shehron ki milakar net badhotri [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

2024 mein shehar ne 3,255 crimes against women register kiye, aur uske state Telangana ka registered crime against women rate kisi bhi state ya union territory mein Delhi ke baad doosra sabse zyada tha: 128.6 per lakh women [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Kisi shehar ki aabaadi do saal mein teen guna nahi hoti. Kuch toh badla: ya hinsa badhi, ya auraton ki police station jaane ki himmat, ya police ki complaint likhne ki tayyari, ya woh section jismein complaint likhi gayi. Numbers yeh nahi bata sakte ki inme se kya badla.

## Classification, registration ya crime?

Teen wajahein ho sakti hain, aur ek se zyada ek saath sach bhi ho sakti hain.

**Crime.** Ho sakta hai ek shehar mein hinsa sach mein badh rahi ho aur doosre mein kam ho. Ise sirf aisa survey test kar sakta hai jo har shehar ki auraton se seedha poochhe.

**Registration.** Complaint statistic tabhi banti hai jab police use register kare. Supreme Court ne 2013 mein kaha tha ki agar complaint se cognizable offence saamne aata hai, toh FIR register karna mandatory hai [[sc-lalita-kumari-2013]]. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ki Section 199 ke under jo public servant rape ki information record nahi karta, use chhah mahine se do saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]], aur rape us 14 din ki preliminary enquiry ke daayre mein nahi aata jo police kuch kam gambhir offences mein kar sakti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Kaagaz par rape complaint ko records se bahar rakhne ka koi legal raasta nahi hai. (Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.) NCRB khud kehta hai ki registration badhna crime badhna nahi hai, aur aisa e-FIR facility ya women help desks jaise kadmon ke baad bhi ho sakta hai [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]].

**Classification.** Ek hi ghatna alag-alag sections mein likhi ja sakti hai. 18 saal se kam umar ki survivors zyada tar POCSO mein gini jaati hain, rape mein nahi: 2024 mein India ke 29,536 rape cases mein se sirf 784 mein victim 18 saal se kam umar ki ladki thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Har FIR sirf ek baar gini jaati hai, uske sabse gambhir offence ke under. States rape aur attempt to rape ke beech cases ko alag-alag tarah baantte bhi hain. 2024 mein West Bengal ne 1,118 rapes ke saamne 809 attempts to rape register kiye, jabki poore India ne 29,536 rapes ke saamne 2,561 attempts [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Ek aur clue peechhe ke darwaze ki jagah aage ke darwaze ki taraf ishara karta hai. 2024 mein Kolkata police ne jitne crime-against-women cases dispose kiye, unme se 98.5% mein charge-sheet file ki, jo 19 shehron mein sabse zyada tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Jo case Kolkata ke records mein aata hai, woh lagbhag hamesha court tak jaata hai. Asli sawaal yeh hai ki records mein aata kya hai, aur kis section mein.

## Police ke liye sawaal

NCRB sirf wahi figures compile karta hai jo state police use bhejti hai, aur kehta hai ki unki authenticity ki zimmedari uski nahi hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Isliye jawab dono shehron ki police ke paas hain. Hum yeh sawaal record par rakhte hain:

- 2022, 2023 aur 2024 mein har force ko adult auraton se sexual violence ki kitni complaints mili, aur woh kis section mein register hui: rape, attempt to rape, aurat ki modesty par hamla, ya kuch aur?
- Kya NCRB ka Kolkata figure sirf Kolkata Police ke area ko cover karta hai, jabki rate nikaalne wali aabaadi ek bade urban area ki hai? Hum ise kisi bhi taraf confirm nahi kar paaye.
- Kitni rape complaints aayi par kabhi FIR ke roop mein register nahi hui, aur kyun?
- Hyderabad mein 2022 ke baad kya badla: help desks, e-FIRs, har complaint register karne ka order, ya zyada hinsa?

Agar Hyderabad ki badhotri ka matlab hai ki auraton ki baat suni ja rahi hai, toh ise samjhaaya jaana chahiye aur doosre shehron mein copy kiya jaana chahiye. Agar Kolkata ki seedhi line ka matlab hai ki auraton ko lauta diya gaya ya unke cases doosre sections mein daal diye gaye, toh ise theek kiya jaana chahiye.

## Shaq wala number kaise pehchaanein

Paanch checks zyada tar jaal pakad lete hain:

1. **Counts nahi, rates compare kijiye, aur sirf ek hi table ke andar.** NCRB city rates 2011 Census ki aabaadi par nikaalta hai aur kehta hai ki city aur state rates comparable nahi hain [[ncrb-cii-2024]].
2. **Aas-paas ke numbers padhiye.** Agar rape ki ginti shehar ke crimes against women, ya uske POCSO cases ka bahut chhota sa hissa hai, toh yeh red flag hai.
3. **Trend dekhiye.** Jo number do saal mein teen guna ho jaye, ya dasiyon lakh logon wale shehar mein ek darjan par atka rahe, use headline se pehle explanation chahiye.
4. **Poochiye ki us saal policing mein kya badla:** naya law, help desk, online complaint system.
5. **NCRB ki apni warning yaad rakhiye:** kisi shehar mein zyada registered crime "not an indicator of its being comparatively unsafe" hai [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]]. Ulta bhi utna hi sach hai.

Kolkata ke 12 aur Hyderabad ke 358 safety ratings nahi hain. Yeh is baat ka record hain ki police ke registers tak kya pahuncha. Jab tak police is gap ki wajah nahi batati, dono ko sawaal ki tarah hi dekhiye.

lockdown-year-lowest-rape-count.en:
In 2020, police in India registered 28,046 rape cases, a rate of 4.3 per lakh women and the lowest count of any year from 2013 to 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2021]]. In the same year, courts convicted the accused in 39.3% of the rape trials they completed [[ncrb-cii-2020-snapshots]], the highest rate of any year from 2012 to 2024. On a chart, 2020 looks like the year India finally got something right. It was the year of the COVID-19 lockdown. Both numbers are accurate. Neither is good news.

## The year the count fell

The year before, police had registered 32,032 rape cases, 4.9 per lakh women. The year after, they registered 31,677, or 4.8 per lakh [[ncrb-cii-2021]]. The dip was not limited to rape. All crimes against women recorded by the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) stood at 3,71,503 in 2020, then jumped to 4,28,278 in 2021 and 4,45,256 in 2022 [[ncrb-cii-2022]].

Some of the fall may have been real. Recorded sexual harassment on public transport dropped from 607 cases in 2019 to 375 in 2020 [[ncrb-cii-2021]], a dip that coincided with the lockdowns. But rape is mostly not a crime of buses and dark roads. The accused was someone the survivor knew in 98.2% of rape cases in 2012 [[ncrb-cii-2012-snapshots]] and in 96.8% in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]: family members, partners, friends, neighbours, employers. A lockdown does not take the men a woman already knows out of her life. For some women, it shuts the door with one of them inside.

## Locked down, locked out

Consider this situation. A 24-year-old woman lives in a one-room home in Kanpur in April 2020. The man she would report is in that room all day. There is no college, no office, no bus to the police station and no hour alone with her phone. Nothing about what is happening to her has changed, except that it can no longer leave the house.

That door was barely open even before the virus. In the National Family Health Survey of 2019-21, only 14% of women who had faced physical or sexual violence had ever sought help, and 77% had never sought help or told anyone. Of those who did seek help, only 6% went to the police: fewer than 1 in 100 of all the women who faced violence [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. A lockdown can only narrow a door that was already almost shut.

Violence at home shows the same jump after 2020. Recorded cases of cruelty by a husband or his relatives stood at 1,11,549 in 2020 and rose by more than a fifth, to 1,36,234, in 2021 [[ncrb-cii-2022]]. Now look at a count that did not rebound. Dowry deaths numbered 6,966 in 2020 and fell to 6,753 in 2021 [[ncrb-cii-2022]]. A death is far harder to keep out of police records than a complaint is. A complaint needs a woman who can reach a police station, or a phone she can use alone.

## A record rate with fewer convictions

The courts tell the same story in a different language. A conviction rate is the number of cases that end in conviction divided by the number of trials completed. NCRB's court-disposal tables show that courts completed 9,713 rape trials in 2020, against 16,701 in 2019. They convicted in 3,814 cases in 2020 [[ncrb-cii-2020-snapshots]]. In 2019 they had convicted in 4,640 [[ncrb-cii-2019-snapshots]].

| Rape trials | 2019 | 2020 |
|---|---|---|
| Trials completed | 16,701 | 9,713 |
| Ended in conviction | 4,640 | 3,814 |
| Conviction rate | 27.8% | 39.3% |

So the record rate came with fewer convictions, not more. No other year from 2012 to 2024 came close; the next highest was 32.2% in 2017 [[ncrb-cii-2017-snapshots]]. NCRB's tables do not say which trials the courts managed to finish in 2020, or why those and not others. The 39.3% cannot be read as courts getting better at rape cases. The trial count shows what changed: they finished far fewer of them.

> A conviction rate can rise while fewer rape cases end in conviction. In 2020, that is exactly what happened.

## The 2021 rebound

When the count came back, it came back fast. Police registered 31,677 rape cases in 2021, and the conviction rate fell back to 28.6% [[ncrb-cii-2021]], close to where it had been before the pandemic. Crimes against women rose to 4,28,278 [[ncrb-cii-2022]].

The trials that were not finished in 2020 did not disappear. They joined the queue. At the end of 2018, 1,38,642 rape cases were waiting for trial [[ncrb-cii-2018]]. By the end of 2021, 1,73,716 were [[ncrb-cii-2021]]. Behind every one of those cases is a survivor who has to keep her account, her witnesses and her nerve intact until a court reaches her file.

## Reading any 'record' with care

NCRB itself warns that a rise in registered crime is not the same as a rise in crime [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. 2020 shows that the warning cuts both ways: a fall in registered crime is not the same as a fall in crime either. Our data story on twelve years of India's rape count finds the same trap in other years, from changes in the law to child cases moving into another table.

So when a minister, a state or a district announces a record, ask three questions. Could people reach the police that year? Could the courts sit? Is a good-looking rate hiding a smaller number underneath? A pandemic, a curfew or a flood can make both crime and justice look better on paper at exactly the moment women can least ask for help.

The practical lesson is about reaching women who cannot leave home. Today, under Section 173 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), a complaint can be made at any police station, whatever the area where the crime happened, or sent electronically as an e-FIR, which must then be signed within three days [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. This is general information, not legal advice. Those routes matter most in the months when the numbers say everything is fine. A record low should always make us ask who could not get through.
lockdown-year-lowest-rape-count.hg:
2020 mein India ki police ne rape ke 28,046 cases register kiye. Rate tha 4.3 per lakh women, aur yeh 2013 se 2024 ke beech kisi bhi saal ka sabse kam count hai [[ncrb-cii-2021]]. Usi saal courts ne rape ke jitne trials poore kiye, unmein se 39.3% mein accused ko convict kiya [[ncrb-cii-2020-snapshots]]. 2012 se 2024 ke beech kisi bhi saal ka yeh sabse ooncha rate hai. Chart par 2020 aisa saal dikhta hai jab India ne aakhirkaar kuch sahi kar diya. Par yeh COVID-19 lockdown ka saal tha. Dono numbers sahi hain. Dono mein se koi bhi achhi khabar nahi hai.

## Jis saal count gira

Ek saal pehle police ne rape ke 32,032 cases register kiye the, yaani 4.9 per lakh women. Ek saal baad 31,677, yaani 4.8 per lakh [[ncrb-cii-2021]]. Yeh girawat sirf rape tak simit nahi thi. National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) ke record mein aurton ke khilaaf saare crimes 2020 mein 3,71,503 the. 2021 mein yeh uchhal kar 4,28,278 ho gaye, aur 2022 mein 4,45,256 [[ncrb-cii-2022]].

Girawat ka kuch hissa shayad asli bhi tha. Public transport mein sexual harassment ke recorded cases 2019 ke 607 se gir kar 2020 mein 375 reh gaye [[ncrb-cii-2021]], aur yeh girawat lockdowns ke saath-saath aayi. Par rape zyada tar buses aur andheri sadakon wala crime nahi hai. 2012 mein rape ke 98.2% cases mein accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha [[ncrb-cii-2012-snapshots]], aur 2024 mein 96.8% cases mein [[ncrb-cii-2024]]: parivaar ke log, partners, dost, padosi, employers. Lockdown un aadmiyon ko aurat ki zindagi se bahar nahi karta jinhe woh pehle se jaanti hai. Kuch aurton ke liye woh darwaza band kar deta hai, aur unmein se ek aadmi andar hi reh jaata hai.

## Ghar mein band, system se bahar

Ek situation sochiye. April 2020 hai. Kanpur mein ek 24 saal ki aurat ek kamre ke ghar mein rehti hai. Jis aadmi ki woh complaint karegi, woh din bhar usi kamre mein hai. Na college hai, na office, na police station tak jaane wali bus, na phone ke saath akele ek ghanta. Uske saath jo ho raha hai, usmein kuch nahi badla. Bas ab woh baat ghar se bahar nahi ja sakti.

Yeh darwaza virus se pehle bhi mushkil se hi khulta tha. National Family Health Survey 2019-21 mein, physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali aurton mein se sirf 14% ne kabhi madad maangi thi, aur 77% ne na madad maangi, na kisi ko kuch bataya. Jinhone madad maangi, unmein se sirf 6% police ke paas gayi: yaani violence jhelne wali saari aurton mein se 100 mein ek se bhi kam [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Lockdown ek pehle se lagbhag band darwaze ko sirf aur sankara hi kar sakta hai.

Ghar ke andar ki violence mein bhi 2020 ke baad yahi uchhaal dikhta hai. Pati ya uske rishtedaaron ki cruelty ke recorded cases 2020 mein 1,11,549 the, aur 2021 mein paanchve hisse se bhi zyada badh kar 1,36,234 ho gaye [[ncrb-cii-2022]]. Ab ek aisa count dekhiye jo 2021 mein wapas nahi uchhla. 2020 mein dowry deaths 6,966 thi, aur 2021 mein ghat kar 6,753 reh gayi [[ncrb-cii-2022]]. Ek maut ko police record se bahar rakhna ek complaint ke muqable kahin zyada mushkil hai. Complaint ke liye aisi aurat chahiye jo police station tak pahunch sake, ya ek aisa phone jo woh akele use kar sake.

## Record rate, par kam convictions

Courts bhi yahi kahani ek alag bhasha mein sunate hain. Conviction rate ka matlab hai: jitne cases conviction par khatam hue, unhe poore hue trials ki sankhya se divide kijiye. NCRB ki court-disposal tables dikhati hain ki 2020 mein courts ne rape ke 9,713 trials poore kiye, jabki 2019 mein 16,701. 2020 mein 3,814 cases mein conviction hua [[ncrb-cii-2020-snapshots]]. 2019 mein convictions 4,640 the [[ncrb-cii-2019-snapshots]].

| Rape trials | 2019 | 2020 |
|---|---|---|
| Poore hue trials | 16,701 | 9,713 |
| Conviction par khatam | 4,640 | 3,814 |
| Conviction rate | 27.8% | 39.3% |

Yaani record rate ke saath convictions badhe nahi, ghat gaye. 2012 se 2024 tak koi aur saal iske kareeb bhi nahi aaya; doosra sabse ooncha rate 2017 ka 32.2% tha [[ncrb-cii-2017-snapshots]]. NCRB ki tables yeh nahi batati ki 2020 mein courts kaun se trials poore kar paaye, aur wahi kyun, baaki kyun nahi. Isliye 39.3% ko is baat ka saboot nahi maana ja sakta ki courts rape cases mein behtar ho gaye. Trials ki ginti batati hai ki asal mein kya badla: courts ne bahut kam trials poore kiye.

> Conviction rate badh sakta hai jabki conviction par khatam hone wale rape cases kam ho jaayein. 2020 mein bilkul yahi hua.

## 2021 mein wapsi

Count jab wapas aaya, toh tezi se aaya. 2021 mein police ne rape ke 31,677 cases register kiye, aur conviction rate gir kar 28.6% par aa gaya [[ncrb-cii-2021]], lagbhag wahin jahan pandemic se pehle tha. Aurton ke khilaaf crimes badh kar 4,28,278 ho gaye [[ncrb-cii-2022]].

Jo trials 2020 mein poore nahi hue, woh gayab nahi hue. Woh queue mein jud gaye. 2018 ke end mein rape ke 1,38,642 cases trial ka intezaar kar rahe the [[ncrb-cii-2018]]. 2021 ke end tak yeh sankhya 1,73,716 ho gayi [[ncrb-cii-2021]]. Har case ke peeche ek survivor hai, jise apna bayan, apne gawah aur apni himmat tab tak sambhaal kar rakhni padti hai jab tak court uski file tak nahi pahunchta.

## Kisi bhi 'record' ko dhyaan se padhiye

NCRB khud warn karta hai ki registered crime ka badhna aur crime ka badhna ek hi baat nahi hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. 2020 dikhata hai ki yeh warning dono taraf lagti hai: registered crime ka girna aur crime ka girna bhi ek hi baat nahi hai. India ke barah saal ke rape count par hamari data story doosre saalon mein bhi yahi jaal dikhati hai, law mein badlav se le kar child cases ke doosri table mein chale jaane tak.

Toh jab koi minister, state ya district kisi record ka elaan kare, toh teen sawaal poochiye. Kya us saal log police tak pahunch paaye? Kya courts mein sunwai ho paayi? Kya ek achha dikhne wala rate apne neeche ek chhota number chhupa raha hai? Pandemic, curfew ya baadh, crime aur insaaf dono ko kaagaz par behtar dikha sakte hain, theek usi waqt jab aurtein sabse kam madad maang paati hain.

Practical sabak un aurton tak pahunchne ka hai jo ghar se bahar nahi nikal sakti. Aaj Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ke Section 173 ke tahat complaint kisi bhi police station mein ki ja sakti hai, crime chahe kisi bhi ilaake mein hua ho. Complaint electronic tareeke se e-FIR ke roop mein bhi bheji ja sakti hai, jis par phir teen din ke andar sign karna hota hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi. Yeh raaste un mahinon mein sabse zyada maayne rakhte hain jab numbers kehte hain ki sab theek hai. Record low dikhe, toh hamesha poochiye: kaun apni baat pahunchaa hi nahi paaya?

lowest-crime-rate-states-not-safest.en:
Imagine a college student in Coimbatore who finds a list of "India's safest states for women" with Tamil Nadu near the top. The numbers behind it are real. In 2024 Tamil Nadu's police registered rape at 1.1 cases per lakh women, against a national rate of 4.3 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. But a police register counts complaints that became FIRs, not violence. A low rate can mean women are safer. It can also mean they are not being heard. A national survey can help tell the two apart.

## The bottom of the table

Nagaland had India's lowest rate of registered crime against women in 2024: 5.1 per lakh women, from 56 cases in the whole year. Next came Manipur (12.0), Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu (18.7), Gujarat (22.0), Ladakh (25.6) and Tamil Nadu (29.4), against a national rate of 64.6 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Gujarat's 7,606 cases gave it the lowest rate of any large state [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

On rape alone, the lowest rates were in Ladakh (0.8, from 1 case), Puducherry (1.0, 9 cases), Tamil Nadu (1.1, 419 cases), Manipur (1.2, 19 cases), Nagaland (1.3, 14 cases) and Andhra Pradesh (1.7, 441 cases) [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Gujarat's was 1.9 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## Survey numbers that don't match

The National Family Health Survey (NFHS) asks women directly about violence by their husbands. It is not a rape count, and its years differ from NCRB's, but it is the nearest thing India has to an independent check.

| State | Crimes against women per lakh women (police, 2024) | Rapes per lakh women (police, 2024) | Ever-married women reporting violence by a husband (NFHS-5, 2019-21) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Nagaland | 5.1 | 1.3 | 6.5% |
| Manipur | 12.0 | 1.2 | 39.6% |
| Tamil Nadu | 29.4 | 1.1 | 38.1% |
| India | 64.6 | 4.3 | 29.2% |

Police figures are from Crime in India 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]; survey figures from NFHS-5 [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Manipur and Tamil Nadu ranked third and fourth in India for violence by husbands, behind only Karnataka (44.4%) and Bihar (40.1%) [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Both are also among the six lowest for registered crime against women. Tamil Nadu stayed near the top in the newer survey, whose fact sheets are still provisional: in NFHS-6 (2023-24), 28.5% of its ever-married women reported such violence, joint third in India, against 22.3% nationally [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]]. Manipur was not surveyed in NFHS-6 [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]].

The sharpest mismatch is in the crime the survey measures. Tamil Nadu's police registered cruelty by a husband or his relatives at 2.2 cases per lakh women in 2024, against 17.6 nationally [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Our map of domestic-violence silence applies this test state by state.

## When silence looks like safety

Most violence never reaches a police station. In NFHS-5, only 14% of women who had faced physical or sexual violence had ever sought help, and 77% had never sought help or told anyone. Of those who did seek help, 6% went to the police [[nfhs5-india-2021]]: fewer than one in a hundred of all the women who faced violence. Wherever that funnel narrows further, a state's rate falls and its "safety" ranking rises.

Belief can narrow it. In NFHS-5, 78% of women in Tamil Nadu said a husband could be justified in beating his wife [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. When most women around you have learnt that a husband's violence can be deserved, walking into a police station to call it a crime gets harder.

Records can stay almost empty even when a court sees more. NCRB's tables show no honour killings in Tamil Nadu from 2020 to 2023 and one in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], yet in June 2026 a Madras High Court judge observed that the state had seen 59 in the past ten years [[livelaw-madras-hc-honour-killings-2026]]. The periods differ and the judge gave no source for the count, but the gap is hard to ignore.

Filing habits matter too. All 419 of Tamil Nadu's rape cases had adult victims; the state files child cases under POCSO, and registered 6,969 of them in 2024, at 33.7 per lakh children [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. And registration can shift fast: its crimes against women jumped 27.1% in 2024, to 11,363 cases, while its rate stayed among India's lowest [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## Where low numbers hold up

Nagaland is where the two sources agree. Its police registered 56 crimes against women and 14 rapes in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], and in NFHS-5 just 6.5% of its ever-married women reported violence by a husband, the lowest of any state; only the union territory of Lakshadweep, at 1.3%, was lower [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. When the register and the survey are both low, violence may genuinely be lower.

Small numbers still need care. Lakshadweep, with the lowest survey figure in India, had a rape rate of 6.7 in 2024, the tenth-highest, from just 2 cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. At this scale, a single FIR more or less can move a territory many places up or down a table.

Gujarat is harder to read. Its rate of crime against women was about a third of the national figure, yet its police registered 2,699 POCSO cases, the tenth-highest count of any state, and its courts convicted in just 9.9% of crime-against-women trials completed in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A low rate beside few convictions could mean less violence, or women who see little point in coming forward. Only a survey placed beside the register can begin to tell.

## Questions for a 'safe' state

Before believing that any state is the safest for women, ask five questions.

1. **How many cases sit behind the rate?** Ladakh's 0.8 is one case.
2. **What does the survey say?** If women tell NFHS about violence at or above the national level, a low police rate is more likely silence than safety.
3. **Where are the children?** A low rape rate can mean child cases went to POCSO. Check both tables.
4. **What do related crimes show?** A state that registers very few cruelty cases while its women describe high violence by husbands is not hearing them.
5. **What does NCRB itself say?** That more crime registered in a city is "not an indicator of its being comparatively unsafe" [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]]. The logic runs both ways: less crime registered is no proof of safety.

A low number deserves a question, not a medal. And for anyone living with violence in a "safe" state, the ranking changes nothing: what happened to you is real whether or not anyone counted it.
lowest-crime-rate-states-not-safest.hg:
Sochiye, Coimbatore ka ek college student "India ke women ke liye sabse safe states" wali ek list dekhta hai, jismein Tamil Nadu upar ke paas hai. Uske peechhe ke numbers asli hain. 2024 mein Tamil Nadu police ne har ek lakh women par rape ke 1.1 cases register kiye, jabki national rate 4.3 tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Par police register violence nahi ginta, woh un complaints ko ginta hai jo FIR bani. Kam rate ka matlab ho sakta hai ki women zyada safe hain. Iska matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki unki baat suni hi nahi ja rahi. Ek national survey in dono ko alag karne mein madad kar sakta hai.

## Table ka sabse neeche wala hissa

2024 mein women ke khilaaf registered crime ka sabse kam rate Nagaland mein tha: har ek lakh women par 5.1, poore saal mein sirf 56 cases. Uske baad Manipur (12.0), Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu (18.7), Gujarat (22.0), Ladakh (25.6) aur Tamil Nadu (29.4) aate hain, jabki national rate 64.6 tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Gujarat ke 7,606 cases ne use bade states mein sabse kam rate diya [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Sirf rape ki baat karein, toh sabse kam rates Ladakh (0.8, sirf 1 case), Puducherry (1.0, 9 cases), Tamil Nadu (1.1, 419 cases), Manipur (1.2, 19 cases), Nagaland (1.3, 14 cases) aur Andhra Pradesh (1.7, 441 cases) mein the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Gujarat ka rate 1.9 tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## Survey ke numbers jo match nahi karte

National Family Health Survey (NFHS) women se seedhe unke pati ki violence ke baare mein poochhta hai. Yeh rape count nahi hai, aur iske saal NCRB ke saalon se alag hain, par India ke paas independent check ke naam par isse qareeb kuch nahi hai.

| State | Har lakh women par crimes against women (police, 2024) | Har lakh women par rapes (police, 2024) | Pati ki violence batane wali ever-married women (NFHS-5, 2019-21) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Nagaland | 5.1 | 1.3 | 6.5% |
| Manipur | 12.0 | 1.2 | 39.6% |
| Tamil Nadu | 29.4 | 1.1 | 38.1% |
| India | 64.6 | 4.3 | 29.2% |

Police ke figures Crime in India 2024 se hain [[ncrb-cii-2024]], aur survey ke figures NFHS-5 se [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Pati ki violence mein Manipur aur Tamil Nadu India mein teesre aur chauthe number par the, sirf Karnataka (44.4%) aur Bihar (40.1%) se peechhe [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Dono women ke khilaaf registered crime ke sabse kam rate wali chhe jagahon mein bhi hain. Naye survey mein bhi Tamil Nadu upar hi raha, haalaanki uski fact sheets abhi provisional hain: NFHS-6 (2023-24) mein wahan ki 28.5% ever-married women ne aisi violence ki baat batayi, jo India mein joint teesra number tha, jabki national figure 22.3% tha [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]]. Manipur NFHS-6 mein survey hi nahi hua [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]].

Sabse bada farq usi crime mein hai jise survey naapta hai. 2024 mein Tamil Nadu police ne pati ya uske rishtedaaron ki cruelty ke cases har ek lakh women par sirf 2.2 darj kiye, jabki national rate 17.6 tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Ghar ki violence par khamoshi ka hamara state-wise map yahi test har state par lagata hai.

## Jab khamoshi safety jaisi dikhti hai

Zyadatar violence kabhi police station tak pahunchti hi nahi. NFHS-5 mein, physical ya sexual violence jhel chuki women mein se sirf 14% ne kabhi madad maangi thi, aur 77% ne na kabhi madad maangi, na kisi ko bataya. Jinhone madad maangi, unmein se 6% police ke paas gayin [[nfhs5-india-2021]]: yaani violence jhelne wali saari women mein se sau mein ek se bhi kam. Jis state mein yeh raasta aur bhi tang ho jaata hai, wahan rate girta hai aur "safety" ranking upar chadhti hai.

Soch is raaste ko aur tang kar sakti hai. NFHS-5 mein Tamil Nadu ki 78% women ne kaha ki pati ka patni ko maarna kuch haalaat mein sahi ho sakta hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Jab aapke aas-paas zyadatar auraton ne yahi seekha ho ki kuch haalaat mein pati ka haath uthana jaayaz hai, tab police station jaakar use crime kehna aur mushkil ho jaata hai.

Records lagbhag khaali reh sakte hain, tab bhi jab court ko kahin zyada dikh raha ho. NCRB ki tables ke hisaab se Tamil Nadu mein 2020 se 2023 tak ek bhi honour killing nahi hui aur 2024 mein sirf ek [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Par June 2026 mein Madras High Court ke ek judge ne kaha ki pichhle das saal mein state mein 59 honour killings hui hain [[livelaw-madras-hc-honour-killings-2026]]. Dono ke saal alag hain aur judge ne is ginti ka source nahi bataya, par yeh farq nazarandaaz karna mushkil hai.

Case file karne ki aadat bhi farq daalti hai. Tamil Nadu ke saare 419 rape cases mein victim adult thi; state bachchon ke cases POCSO mein file karta hai, aur 2024 mein aise 6,969 cases register hue, yaani har ek lakh bachchon par 33.7 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Aur registration tezi se badal bhi sakta hai: 2024 mein wahan women ke khilaaf crimes 27.1% badh kar 11,363 cases ho gaye, phir bhi uska rate India ke sabse kam rates mein hi raha [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## Jahan kam numbers sach mein tikte hain

Nagaland woh jagah hai jahan dono sources ek hi baat kehte hain. 2024 mein wahan police ne women ke khilaaf 56 crimes aur 14 rapes darj kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]], aur NFHS-5 mein wahan ki sirf 6.5% ever-married women ne pati ki violence ki baat batayi, jo kisi bhi state mein sabse kam tha; sirf union territory Lakshadweep, 1.3% ke saath, isse neeche tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Jab register aur survey dono kam hon, tab ho sakta hai ki violence sach mein kam ho.

Phir bhi chhote numbers ko dhyaan se padhna padta hai. Lakshadweep, jiska survey figure India mein sabse kam hai, uska 2024 ka rape rate 6.7 tha, jo desh mein dasva sabse oonchaa tha, aur woh bhi sirf 2 cases se [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Itne chhote paimane par sirf ek FIR ka kam ya zyada hona kisi territory ko table mein kai number upar ya neeche kar sakta hai.

Gujarat ko padhna zyada mushkil hai. Wahan women ke khilaaf crime ka rate national figure ka lagbhag ek-tihaai tha, phir bhi wahan police ne POCSO ke 2,699 cases register kiye, jo kisi bhi state mein dasva sabse bada count tha, aur 2024 mein wahan ki courts ne crime against women ke poore hue trials mein se sirf 9.9% mein conviction diya [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Kam rate aur kam convictions ka matlab kam violence bhi ho sakta hai, ya yeh bhi ki women ko aage aane ka koi faayda nahi dikhta. Register ke bagal mein survey rakhne se hi iska jawab milna shuru ho sakta hai.

## Ek 'safe' state se poochhne layak sawaal

Kisi bhi state ko women ke liye sabse safe maanne se pehle yeh paanch sawaal poochhiye.

1. **Rate ke peechhe kitne cases hain?** Ladakh ka 0.8 sirf ek case hai.
2. **Survey kya kehta hai?** Agar women NFHS ko national level ke barabar ya usse zyada violence batati hain, toh police ka kam rate safety ki kam, khamoshi ki nishani zyada ho sakta hai.
3. **Bachche kahan hain?** Kam rape rate ka matlab yeh ho sakta hai ki bachchon ke cases POCSO mein gaye. Dono tables check kijiye.
4. **Judey hue crimes kya dikhate hain?** Jo state cruelty ke bahut kam cases darj karta hai, jabki wahan ki women pati ki bhaari violence batati hain, woh apni auraton ki sun nahi raha.
5. **NCRB khud kya kehta hai?** Yahi ki kisi shehar mein zyada crime darj hona "not an indicator of its being comparatively unsafe" hai, yaani woh jagah doosri se kam safe hai, iska saboot nahi [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]]. Yeh logic ulta bhi chalta hai: kam crime darj hona bhi safety ka saboot nahi.

Kam number ek sawaal ka haqdaar hai, medal ka nahi. Aur jo kisi "safe" state mein violence jhel raha hai, uske liye yeh ranking kuch nahi badalti: aapke saath jo hua, woh sach hai, chahe kisi ne use gina ho ya nahi.

metro-city-rape-rates-census-problem.en:
Imagine a 20-year-old in Jaipur who opens a forward calling her city "India's most unsafe city for women". The number behind it is real. In 2024 Jaipur's police registered 497 rape cases, a rate of 34.2 per lakh women, the highest of the 19 big cities in the National Crime Records Bureau's (NCRB) tables [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. What the forward leaves out is the bottom half of the fraction. The "per lakh women" in that rate comes from a population counted in 2011.

## The 2024 city league table

Together, the 19 cities registered 3,886 rape cases in 2024. Delhi had 1,058 of them, or 27.2%, followed by Jaipur (497), Mumbai (411), Hyderabad (358), Pune (244), Indore (195), Bengaluru (168) and Lucknow (161) [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Rank the cities by rate instead of count and the order changes.

| City | Rape cases, 2024 | Rate per lakh women |
|---|---|---|
| Jaipur | 497 | 34.2 |
| Indore | 195 | 18.8 |
| Delhi | 1,058 | 14.0 |
| Lucknow | 161 | 11.6 |
| Chennai | 44 | 1.0 |
| Kolkata | 12 | 0.2 |

Nagpur completes the top five at 11.1 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The wider measure, all registered crimes against women, has a similar top: Jaipur at 199.0 per lakh women, then Lucknow (186.0), Indore (181.5), Delhi (176.8), Kanpur (146.1), Patna (129.2) and Nagpur (123.8). Chennai (25.4) and Kolkata (28.8) sit at the bottom [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

So far, this is honest arithmetic. The trouble is in what it divides by.

## The 2011 denominator problem

A rate is cases divided by population. For states, NCRB uses a projected population for 2024. Projections do not exist for cities, so NCRB calculates city rates on the 2011 Census, and says plainly that state and city rates are "not comparable" [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Delhi shows how much the bottom of the fraction matters. Its police registered 13,396 crimes against women in 2024, and the same 13,396 cases appear in both of NCRB's tables. As a union territory, divided by its projected 2024 population, that is 130.7 per lakh women. As a city, divided by the 2011 Census, it is 176.8 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Rape works the same way: the same 1,058 cases give a rate of 10.3 in the state table and 14.0 in the city table [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Part of the gap is geography, because Delhi UT also includes rural Delhi [[ncrb-cii-2024-methodology]]. None of it is crime.

The logic runs one way. Any city that has grown since 2011 has more women today than the 2011 count assumes, so its rate is overstated, and the faster it grew, the bigger the error. NCRB does not publish population projections for cities, so a reader cannot correct for this from the report.

A frozen denominator has a second effect: a city's rate can move only when its count moves. Jaipur registered 497 rape cases in 2022, 573 in 2023 (a rate of 39.4) and 497 again in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2022]] [[ncrb-cii-2023]] [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Its rate in 2022 and in 2024 is the same 34.2, as if no one had moved to the city in between.

## 34 cities missing from print

The 19 are not all of urban India. NCRB collects data for 53 metropolitan cities, those with more than 10 lakh people in the 2011 Census, but prints tables only for the 19 that had more than 20 lakh. Figures for the other 34 sit on NCRB's website [[ncrb-cii-2024-methodology]]. A "most unsafe city" ranking built on the printed tables can only ever rank these 19.

The list is frozen too. Because the 53 were chosen by their 2011 populations, a city that has crossed 10 lakh since then is not tracked as a metropolitan city at all.

The bottom of the printed table needs as much care as the top. Kolkata's 12 rape cases gave it a rate of 0.2, yet it registered 1,958 crimes against women in all [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Chennai's 44 rape cases sat beside 437 cases under the POCSO Act with girl victims [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Across Tamil Nadu, not one rape case in 2024 had a victim under 18; child sexual abuse there is recorded under the child-protection law instead [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Chennai's short rape row beside a much longer POCSO row fits that pattern. A low rape rate can be a filing habit as easily as a safe street.

## Reading your own city's number

If you live in Patna, Pune, Jaipur or any other printed city, here is how to read your line without being fooled.

1. **Start with the count.** Pune's 244 rape cases were the fifth-highest of the 19 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The count is how many FIRs police wrote. The rate divides that by a 2011 headcount.
2. **Compare your city with itself.** Because the denominator never changes, a rise or fall in a city's rate from one year to the next is a real rise or fall in registered cases. Setting Jaipur's 34.2 beside Rajasthan's state rate, or beside another city's, is not a fair test.
3. **Look beside the rape line.** Check the POCSO table, where most child rape is counted: Pune registered 575 POCSO cases with girl victims, the fourth-highest of the 19 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Check the charge-sheeting rate too. Jaipur's police charge-sheeted 55.7% of the crime-against-women cases they disposed of in 2024, the lowest of the 19, while Kolkata's charge-sheeted 98.5%, the highest [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A city that writes down many complaints but takes fewer to court has a different problem from a city that writes down very few.
4. **Remember what never reaches the table.** Patna's crime-against-women rate of 129.2 is sixth of the 19 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], but every city's figure is a floor. Across India, 77% of women who had faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

NCRB's own warning applies to every row: more crime registered in a city is "not an indicator of its being comparatively unsafe" [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]]. A high rate can mean more violence, more reporting, a grown city divided by an old count, or all three. Before you believe any city ranking, ask what sits at the bottom of the fraction.
metro-city-rape-rates-census-problem.hg:
Sochiye, Jaipur ki ek 20 saal ki ladki ke phone par ek forward aata hai, jismein uske shehar ko "women ke liye India ka sabse unsafe shehar" kaha gaya hai. Uske peechhe ka number asli hai. 2024 mein Jaipur police ne rape ke 497 cases register kiye, yaani har ek lakh women par 34.2. National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) ki tables ke 19 bade shehron mein yeh sabse oonchi rate thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Forward jo nahi batata, woh hai fraction ka neeche wala hissa. Is rate mein jo "har ek lakh women" hai, woh aabadi 2011 mein gini gayi thi.

## 2024 ki city league table

19 shehron ne milkar 2024 mein rape ke 3,886 cases register kiye. Inmein se 1,058, yaani 27.2%, akele Delhi ke the. Uske baad Jaipur (497), Mumbai (411), Hyderabad (358), Pune (244), Indore (195), Bengaluru (168) aur Lucknow (161) aate hain [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Shehron ko count ki jagah rate se rank kijiye, toh order badal jaata hai.

| Shehar | Rape cases, 2024 | Har lakh women par rate |
|---|---|---|
| Jaipur | 497 | 34.2 |
| Indore | 195 | 18.8 |
| Delhi | 1,058 | 14.0 |
| Lucknow | 161 | 11.6 |
| Chennai | 44 | 1.0 |
| Kolkata | 12 | 0.2 |

Top five mein paanchva naam Nagpur ka hai, 11.1 ke saath [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Bada paimana, yaani women ke khilaaf darj saare crimes, dekhiye toh upar ki list milti-julti hai: Jaipur har lakh women par 199.0 ke saath sabse upar, phir Lucknow (186.0), Indore (181.5), Delhi (176.8), Kanpur (146.1), Patna (129.2) aur Nagpur (123.8). Sabse neeche Chennai (25.4) aur Kolkata (28.8) hain [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Yahan tak hisaab bilkul imaandaar hai. Gadbad us number mein hai jisse divide kiya ja raha hai.

## 2011 ke denominator ki problem

Rate ka matlab hai cases ko aabadi se divide karna. States ke liye NCRB 2024 ki projected aabadi use karta hai. Shehron ke liye aise projections hain hi nahi, isliye NCRB shehron ke rates 2011 Census par nikalta hai, aur saaf kehta hai ki state aur city ke rates "not comparable" hain, yaani inki tulna nahi ho sakti [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Fraction ka neeche wala hissa kitna farq daalta hai, yeh Delhi dikhata hai. 2024 mein Delhi police ne women ke khilaaf 13,396 crimes register kiye, aur yahi 13,396 cases NCRB ki dono tables mein hain. Union territory ke roop mein, 2024 ki projected aabadi se divide karne par, yeh har lakh women par 130.7 banta hai. Shehar ke roop mein, 2011 Census se divide karne par, 176.8 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Rape mein bhi yahi hota hai: wahi 1,058 cases state table mein 10.3 ka rate dete hain aur city table mein 14.0 ka [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Is farq ka kuch hissa geography ka hai, kyunki Delhi UT mein rural Delhi bhi shamil hai [[ncrb-cii-2024-methodology]]. Par ismein crime ka koi hissa nahi hai.

Yeh logic ek hi taraf chalta hai. Jo bhi shehar 2011 ke baad bada hua hai, wahan aaj 2011 ki ginti se zyada women rehti hain. Isliye uska rate asal se zyada dikhta hai, aur shehar jitni tezi se bada hua, galti utni hi badi. NCRB shehron ke liye aabadi ke projections publish nahi karta, isliye koi reader report se is galti ko theek nahi kar sakta.

Jami hui aabadi ka ek doosra asar bhi hai: kisi shehar ka rate tabhi hilta hai jab uska count hile. Jaipur ne 2022 mein rape ke 497 cases register kiye, 2023 mein 573 (rate 39.4), aur 2024 mein phir se 497 [[ncrb-cii-2022]] [[ncrb-cii-2023]] [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. 2022 aur 2024 dono mein uska rate wahi 34.2 hai, jaise beech ke saalon mein koi shehar mein aaya hi na ho.

## 34 shehar print se gayab

Yeh 19 shehar poora urban India nahi hain. NCRB 53 metro shehron ka data jama karta hai, yaani woh shehar jinki aabadi 2011 Census mein 10 lakh se zyada thi. Par tables sirf un 19 ki print hoti hain jinki aabadi 20 lakh se zyada thi. Baaki 34 ke figures NCRB ki website par padhe rehte hain [[ncrb-cii-2024-methodology]]. Print wali tables par bani koi bhi "sabse unsafe shehar" ranking sirf inhi 19 shehron ko rank kar sakti hai.

Yeh list bhi jami hui hai. 53 shehar 2011 ki aabadi ke hisaab se chune gaye the, isliye jo shehar uske baad 10 lakh paar kar gaya, use metro shehar ke roop mein track hi nahi kiya jaata.

Print table ka neeche wala hissa bhi utni hi savdhani maangta hai jitna upar wala. Kolkata ke 12 rape cases ne use 0.2 ka rate diya, jabki wahan women ke khilaaf kul 1,958 crimes darj hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Chennai ke 44 rape cases ke saath POCSO Act mein girl victims wale 437 cases bhi darj the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Poore Tamil Nadu mein 2024 mein ek bhi rape case mein victim 18 saal se kam ki nahi thi; wahan child sexual abuse rape sections ki jagah child-protection law mein darj hota hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Chennai ki chhoti rape row aur uske bagal ki kahin lambi POCSO row isi pattern mein fit hoti hai. Kam rape rate kisi safe sadak ki nishani bhi ho sakta hai, aur sirf file karne ki aadat bhi.

## Apne shehar ka number kaise padhein

Agar aap Patna, Pune, Jaipur ya print hone wale kisi aur shehar mein rehte hain, toh bina dhokha khaaye apni line aise padhiye.

1. **Count se shuru kijiye.** Pune ke 244 rape cases 19 shehron mein paanchve number par the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Count batata hai ki police ne kitni FIR likhin. Rate us count ko 2011 ki headcount se divide karta hai.
2. **Apne shehar ko usi se compare kijiye.** Kyunki denominator kabhi nahi badalta, isliye ek saal se agle saal tak shehar ke rate mein utaar-chadhaav darj cases ka asli utaar-chadhaav hai. Jaipur ke 34.2 ko Rajasthan ke state rate ke saath, ya kisi doosre shehar ke rate ke saath rakhna, sahi test nahi hai.
3. **Rape line ke bagal mein bhi dekhiye.** POCSO table check kijiye, jahan bachchon ke zyadatar rape cases gine jaate hain: Pune ne girl victims wale 575 POCSO cases register kiye, jo 19 shehron mein chautha sabse bada count tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Charge-sheeting rate bhi dekhiye. 2024 mein Jaipur police ne women ke khilaaf crime ke jitne cases nipataye, unmein se 55.7% mein charge-sheet daali, jo 19 shehron mein sabse kam tha, jabki Kolkata police ne 98.5% mein, jo sabse zyada tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Jo shehar bahut saari complaints likhta hai par kam cases court tak le jaata hai, uski problem us shehar se alag hai jo bahut kam complaints likhta hai.
4. **Yaad rakhiye ki kya kabhi table tak pahunchta hi nahi.** Patna ka crime against women rate 129.2 hai, jo 19 shehron mein chhatha hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]], par har shehar ka figure sirf minimum hai. Poore India mein, physical ya sexual violence jhel chuki 77% women ne na kabhi madad maangi, na kisi ko bataya [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

NCRB ki apni chetavni har row par laagu hoti hai: kisi shehar mein zyada crime darj hona "not an indicator of its being comparatively unsafe" hai, yaani is baat ka saboot nahi ki woh shehar doosre se kam safe hai [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]]. Oonche rate ka matlab ho sakta hai zyada violence, zyada reporting, purani ginti se divide kiya gaya bada ho chuka shehar, ya teeno. Kisi bhi city ranking par bharosa karne se pehle poochhiye ki fraction ke neeche kya baitha hai.

ncrb-false-rape-cases-explained.en:
Every year, one number from the National Crime Records Bureau's *Crime in India* gets passed around as proof that women lie about rape. In the 2024 data, police closed 3,776 rape cases as "false" [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The number is real. What it is usually said to mean is not. It counts files that investigating officers closed with a particular label, not complaints any court found to be invented.

## How police close a case

When police finish investigating an FIR, they either file a charge-sheet, which sends the accused for trial, or a final report, which closes the case. NCRB sorts final reports by the reason police gave. Here is what happened to the 30,272 rape cases police disposed of in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]:

| Police decision on rape cases, 2024 | Cases |
|---|---|
| Charge-sheet filed: accused sent for trial | 24,614 |
| Closed as "false" | 3,776 |
| Closed as true, but evidence insufficient or accused untraced | 1,044 |
| Closed as a mistake of fact or law, or a civil dispute | 714 |
| All cases disposed of by police | 30,272 |

A few others were transferred or ended for other reasons. "True but untraced" means police accepted that a crime happened but could not prove who did it, or find him. "Mistake of fact or law, or civil dispute" means the officer decided the matter was something other than the crime alleged. "False" records the officer's conclusion that the complaint was untrue.

That conclusion is the police's view, not a judgment, and no court has tested it at that stage. Under Section 193(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), police must update the informant or the victim on the investigation within 90 days [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## 3,776 in context

Police filed charge-sheets in 24,614 rape cases, a charge-sheeting rate of 81.3% [[ncrb-cii-2024]]: more than four in five cases went to court. The "false" closures were about one in eight.

They also span more than one year. Police close old files as well as new ones, and 8,905 rape cases were still under investigation at the end of 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. So 3,776 is not a share of the 29,536 rape FIRs registered that year [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Then look at who writes the label. Across all crimes against women, police closed 36,895 cases as "false" in 2024, and Rajasthan's police alone closed 12,217 of them, a third [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yet Rajasthan registered 36,563 of India's 4,41,534 crimes against women that year, fewer than one in ten [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Its charge-sheeting rate, 54.1%, was the lowest of any state or union territory, against 77.2% nationally [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The label varies by crime too: for cruelty by a husband or his relatives, police closed 4,593 of 1,20,390 disposed cases as "false", about 3.8% [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

A column that measured women's honesty would not swing this much with the police force writing it or the crime it is filed under. It tells you at least as much about how police close files as about the people who complain.

## What the label does not tell you

NCRB records how many cases were closed as "false", not why [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The table cannot tell apart a complaint the officer believed was invented, one a survivor withdrew after months of pressure, and an investigation too thin to find evidence that existed.

Consider a hypothetical. A 19-year-old in Jaipur files a rape complaint against a neighbour. For months his relatives visit her parents, offering money and warning of "consequences". She stops answering the investigating officer's calls, then tells him she does not want to go on. If the file is closed as "false", she joins the 3,776, in the same column as a complaint that was made up.

None of this means no complaint is ever false. Some are, and a false accusation does real damage to the person named. But this column cannot tell you how many, and nobody should pretend it can.

The 1,044 "true but untraced" closures deserve a line of their own. In those cases, police accepted that a rape happened and still brought no one to trial.

## Acquittal is not a verdict on honesty

The second "proof" comes from the courts. In 2024 they completed 20,587 rape trials, convicting in 5,032 and acquitting in 13,980: a conviction rate of 24.4% [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Across all crimes against women it was 25.7% [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

An acquittal means guilt was not proved beyond reasonable doubt. It can follow a weak investigation, hostile witnesses, a compromise or a false complaint, and NCRB's figures do not say which. Verdicts also come slowly: 1,85,785 rape cases, 89.8% of those before the courts, were pending at the end of 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Our myth-buster on what a complaint costs a woman follows those years.

The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook on gender stereotypes lists the belief that women are very likely to make false rape allegations among the stereotypes it rejects, and says a delay in reporting is not a sign of lying [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. The law, too, does not treat an acquittal as the end of a victim's claim: the BNSS allows compensation after an acquittal, and even when no trial takes place [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## Reading the 'false cases' headline

Put four questions to the next "false rape cases" figure you see.

1. **Who decided?** A police closure and a court verdict are different things, and neither is a finding that a woman lied.
2. **Out of what?** The 3,776 were among 30,272 cases police disposed of, from more than one year.
3. **Where?** One state's police wrote a third of all "false" closures in crimes against women.
4. **What is missing?** The bigger gap runs the other way. In NFHS-5 (2019-21), 77% of women aged 18-49 who had faced physical or sexual violence had never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

A "false" label is a line in a police file. It deserves scrutiny, like every police decision. It does not deserve to be passed off as a verdict on women.

This is general information, not legal advice.
ncrb-false-rape-cases-explained.hg:
Har saal jab National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) *Crime in India* publish karta hai, toh usmein se ek number utha kar is baat ke saboot ki tarah ghumaaya jaata hai ki aurtein rape ke baare mein jhooth bolti hain. 2024 ke data mein police ne 3,776 rape cases ko "false" bata kar band kiya [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Number sach hai. Uska jo matlab aksar bataya jaata hai, woh sach nahi hai. Yeh un files ki ginti hai jinhe investigating officers ne ek khaas label laga kar band kiya, un complaints ki nahi jinhe kisi court ne gadhi hui paaya ho.

## Police case kaise band karti hai

Jab police kisi FIR ki investigation poori karti hai, toh ya toh charge-sheet file karti hai, jisse accused par trial chalta hai, ya final report, jisse case band ho jaata hai. NCRB final reports ko police ki di hui wajah ke hisaab se alag-alag ginta hai. 2024 mein police ne jin 30,272 rape cases ko dispose kiya, unke saath yeh hua [[ncrb-cii-2024]]:

| 2024 mein rape cases par police ka faisla | Cases |
|---|---|
| Charge-sheet file hui: accused par trial chalega | 24,614 |
| "False" bata kar band | 3,776 |
| Sach maana, par saboot kam ya accused ka pata nahi | 1,044 |
| Mistake of fact ya law, ya civil dispute bata kar band | 714 |
| Police ke dispose kiye kul cases | 30,272 |

Kuch aur cases transfer hue ya doosri wajahon se khatam hue. "True but untraced" ka matlab hai ki police ne maana ki crime hua, par yeh saabit nahi kar paayi ki kisne kiya, ya use dhoondh nahi paayi. "Mistake of fact or law, or civil dispute" ka matlab hai ki officer ke hisaab se maamla aarop wale crime ke bajaye kuch aur tha. "False" officer ka yeh nateeja darj karta hai ki complaint sach nahi thi.

Yeh nateeja police ki raay hai, faisla nahi, aur us stage par kisi court ne ise parkha nahi hota. Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ke Section 193(3) ke tahat police ko 90 din ke andar informant ya victim ko investigation ka update dena hota hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## 3,776 ko context mein dekhiye

Police ne 24,614 rape cases mein charge-sheet file ki, yaani 81.3% ka charge-sheeting rate [[ncrb-cii-2024]]: paanch mein se chaar se zyada cases court tak gaye. "False" closures lagbhag aath mein se ek the.

Yeh cases ek se zyada saal ke bhi hain. Police nayi files ke saath purani files bhi band karti hai, aur 2024 ke aakhir tak 8,905 rape cases ki investigation abhi chal hi rahi thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Isliye 3,776 us saal register hui 29,536 rape FIRs ka hissa nahi hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Ab dekhiye ki yeh label likhta kaun hai. Crimes against women ke saare cases mein, 2024 mein police ne 36,895 cases "false" bata kar band kiye, aur inmein se 12,217 akele Rajasthan police ne band kiye: ek-tihai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Jabki us saal India ke 4,41,534 crimes against women mein se Rajasthan mein 36,563 register hue, das mein se ek se bhi kam [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Rajasthan ka charge-sheeting rate, 54.1%, kisi bhi state ya union territory mein sabse kam tha, jabki national rate 77.2% tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Label crime ke hisaab se bhi badalta hai: pati ya uske rishtedaaron ki cruelty ke cases mein police ne 1,20,390 disposed cases mein se 4,593 ko "false" bata kar band kiya, lagbhag 3.8% [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Agar yeh column aurton ki imaandaari naapta, toh yeh is baat se itna nahi badalta ki use kaunsi police force likh rahi hai, ya case kis crime mein file hua hai. Yeh complaint karne walon ke baare mein jitna batata hai, kam se kam utna hi yeh batata hai ki police files kaise band karti hai.

## Label kya nahi batata

NCRB record karta hai ki kitne cases "false" bata kar band hue, yeh nahi ki kyun [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Table yeh farq nahi kar sakti ki kaunsi complaint officer ko gadhi hui lagi, kaunsi survivor ne mahinon ke dabaav ke baad wapas le li, aur kahan investigation itni kamzor thi ki jo saboot maujood the, woh bhi nahi mile.

Ek hypothetical sochiye. Jaipur ki ek 19 saal ki ladki apne padosi ke khilaaf rape ki complaint karti hai. Mahinon tak padosi ke rishtedaar uske maa-baap ke paas aate rehte hain, paise offer karte hain aur "anjaam" ki dhamki dete hain. Woh investigating officer ka phone uthana band kar deti hai, phir use bata deti hai ki woh case aage nahi badhana chahti. Agar file "false" likh kar band hoti hai, toh woh un 3,776 mein shamil ho jaati hai, usi column mein jismein ek gadhi hui complaint hoti.

Iska matlab yeh nahi ki koi complaint kabhi jhoothi nahi hoti. Kuch hoti hain, aur jhootha aarop jis insaan par lagta hai, use sach mein nuksaan pahunchata hai. Par yeh column nahi bata sakta ki kitni, aur kisi ko yeh dikhaava nahi karna chahiye ki yeh bata sakta hai.

1,044 "true but untraced" closures par alag se dhyaan dena chahiye. In cases mein police ne maana ki rape hua tha, phir bhi kisi par trial nahi chala.

## Acquittal imaandaari par faisla nahi hai

Doosra "saboot" courts se aata hai. 2024 mein courts ne 20,587 rape trials poore kiye: 5,032 mein conviction hua aur 13,980 mein acquittal, yaani 24.4% ka conviction rate [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Crimes against women ke saare cases mein yeh rate 25.7% tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Acquittal ka matlab hai ki guilt reasonable doubt se pare saabit nahi hua. Iske peeche kamzor investigation, hostile witnesses, compromise ya jhoothi complaint, kuch bhi ho sakta hai, aur NCRB ke figures nahi batate ki kaunsa. Faisle bhi dheere aate hain: 2024 ke aakhir tak 1,85,785 rape cases, yaani courts ke saamne maujood cases ka 89.8%, pending the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Complaint karne ki aurat ko kya keemat chukaani padti hai, is par hamara myth-buster un saalon ko detail mein dikhata hai.

Supreme Court ki gender stereotypes par 2023 ki handbook is soch ko un stereotypes mein ginti hai jinhe woh reject karti hai ki aurton ke rape ke jhoothe aarop lagane ki bahut sambhavna hoti hai, aur kehti hai ki report karne mein der jhooth ki nishaani nahi hai [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. Law bhi acquittal ko victim ke daawe ka ant nahi maanta: BNSS acquittal ke baad bhi compensation ki ijaazat deta hai, aur tab bhi jab koi trial hota hi nahi [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## 'False cases' wali headline kaise padhein

Agla "false rape cases" figure jab aapke saamne aaye, toh usse yeh chaar sawaal poochhiye.

1. **Faisla kisne kiya?** Police closure aur court ka verdict alag cheezein hain, aur dono mein se koi bhi yeh nateeja nahi hai ki aurat ne jhooth bola.
2. **Kis ginti mein se?** Yeh 3,776 un 30,272 cases mein se the jinhe police ne dispose kiya, aur yeh ek se zyada saal ke the.
3. **Kahan?** Crimes against women ke saare "false" closures ka ek-tihai ek hi state ki police ne likha.
4. **Kya chhoot raha hai?** Asli kami doosri taraf hai. NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein, physical ya sexual violence jhel chuki 18-49 saal ki 77% aurton ne na kabhi madad maangi, na kisi ko bataya [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Ek "false" label police file ki ek line hai. Har police faisle ki tarah iski bhi jaanch honi chahiye. Par ise aurton par faisla bana kar pesh nahi kiya jaana chahiye.

Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

northeast-sexual-violence-data-outliers.en:
Pick almost any table in India's crime statistics for 2024 and a north-eastern state sits at one end of it. Arunachal Pradesh registered rape at 9.9 cases per lakh women, more than double the national rate of 4.3 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Nagaland had the country's lowest rate of registered crime against women, 5.1, and Manipur the second-lowest, 12.0 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Sikkim, Mizoram and Meghalaya rank among the five states with the highest POCSO rates. And three of the four states where rape accused were least often known to the survivor are in the region. This story asks which of these outliers say something about violence, and which say more about how violence gets counted.

## Arunachal's high rate, Nagaland's low one

Arunachal's 9.9 is the fifth-highest of India's 36 states and union territories, behind Chandigarh, Goa, Rajasthan and Delhi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. It comes from 76 registered cases. Yet Arunachal's rate for all crimes against women, 41.8, is well below the national 64.6. Rape made up 76 of its 321 registered crimes against women; across India, it was 29,536 of 4,41,534 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Rape is a far bigger share of what reaches the police in Arunachal than in the country as a whole.

The table cannot say why. It could be more violence, more complaints being registered, or a filing choice. Most states record the rape of a girl under 18 under POCSO, but not all: in Chandigarh, which tops the rape table, 47 of its 96 rape cases had victims under 18 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

At the other end, Nagaland's police registered 56 crimes against women in all of 2024, 14 of them rapes; Manipur registered 19 rapes. Their rape rates, 1.3 and 1.2, are among the six lowest in India [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

A survey helps separate quiet from safe. In NFHS-5 (2019-21), 6.5% of ever-married women in Nagaland reported physical or sexual violence by a husband, the lowest of any state. In Manipur it was 39.6%, the third-highest after Karnataka and Bihar, against 29.2% nationally [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Violence in marriage is not a rape count, and the years differ. But where both are low, as in Nagaland, they point the same way. Where only the police figure is low, as in Manipur, silence is the likelier reading. The next survey round, NFHS-6, did not cover Manipur at all [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]].

## Child cases: Sikkim, Mizoram, Meghalaya

Kerala had the highest POCSO rate among states in 2024, 48.0 cases per lakh children. Next came Sikkim (36.7), Mizoram (36.4), Tamil Nadu (33.7) and Meghalaya (30.7), against a national 15.6 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yet the registered rape rates of all three north-eastern states were below the national 4.3: Sikkim 2.1, Mizoram 3.2, Meghalaya 3.4. Meghalaya's police registered 424 cases under POCSO, which counts child sexual offences from harassment to penetrative assault, and 57 under the rape law [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

A high POCSO rate is not proof that more children are abused. NCRB itself warns that "rise in crime" and "increase in registration of crime by police" are two different things [[ncrb-cii-2024-word-of-caution]]. Under POCSO, anyone who knows of child sexual abuse must report it [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Imagine a 13-year-old in Shillong who tells her class teacher about an uncle. If the teacher goes to the police, she becomes one of Meghalaya's 424 cases. If the same thing happens where teachers stay quiet, she is never counted, and that state looks safer on paper. Our story on POCSO's quiet states makes this argument for Bihar (5.2) and Uttar Pradesh (9.5).

Two cautions remain. Child rates are calculated on the 2011 Census child population, which may be far from today's. And the region's largest state tells a different story again: Assam registered 2,920 POCSO cases, the seventh-highest count of any state [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## Fewer known offenders?

Nationally, the accused was known to the survivor in 96.8% of rape cases in 2024; in 939 of 29,536 cases the offender was unknown or never identified [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The known share was above 90% almost everywhere. The lowest four were Nagaland (78.6%), Meghalaya (78.9%), West Bengal (84.9%) and Mizoram (85.0%) [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Now count the cases behind them. Nagaland's 78.6% means 3 of its 14 cases had an unknown or unidentified accused. Mizoram's 85.0% means 3 of 20. Meghalaya's 78.9% means 12 of 57. Between them, fewer than 20 cases, against 939 across India.

Two readings fit. Strangers may really be a bigger share of the few cases that reach the police here.
