- **Pehle bharosa kijiye.** Kahiye, "Mujhe tum par bharosa hai" aur "Isme tumhari koi galti nahi hai." Kapde, time ya "chillayi kyun nahi" jaise sawaalon se kisi ka bhala nahi hota.
- **Family meeting se pehle hospital.** Koi bhi hospital, sarkari ya private, usi din. Kanoon ke hisaab se ilaaj free hai. 72 ghante ke andar PEP [[who-pep]] aur 5 din ke andar emergency contraception [[who-ec]] ke baare mein zaroor poochhiye.
- **Adult survivor ko FIR ka faisla khud karne dijiye.** Crime kahin bhi hua ho, koi bhi police station complaint register karega (Zero FIR). Complaint online bhi bheji ja sakti hai, jis par 3 din ke andar sign karna hota hai, aur FIR ki copy free milti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. One Stop Centres violence jhel rahi auraton ko ek hi chhat ke neeche support dete hain. July 2026 tak approve hue 1,033 centres mein se 985 chal rahe the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]].
- **Survivor 18 se kam umar ka hai, toh report kijiye.** POCSO ke hisaab se child sexual abuse ke baare mein jise bhi pata ho, use police ya Special Juvenile Police Unit ko report karna zaroori hai. Report na karne par 6 mahine tak ki jail, fine ya dono ho sakte hain [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. Child Helpline 1098, jo 112 emergency system se judi hai, bhi madad kar sakti hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. Call karne se pehle bachche ko bataiye, aur uske saath rahiye.
- **Apna bhi khayal rakhiye.** Tele-MANAS Health Ministry ki free helpline hai jo din-raat chalti hai. Number hai 14416 [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

Batane wala aapki beti ho, beta ho, bhai ho ya koi transgender dost, yeh baatein sab par laagu hoti hain. Jo survivors help maangte hain, unmein se zyada tar ki shuruaat aap jaise kisi apne se hi hoti hai.

what-rape-statistics-cannot-show.en:
In 2024, police in India registered 29,536 rape cases involving 29,742 victims, a rate of 4.3 per lakh women [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. It is the most quoted number on sexual violence in the country, and it is a real record of real complaints. But the number has edges, and the people outside them are not there by chance. Some are excluded by the law, some by the way the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) files cases, and some by silence and time. Here are seven blind spots, and where each one comes from.

## The official number and its edges

The rape figure counts FIRs registered under the rape sections, each FIR once. NCRB does not collect cases itself; it compiles what state and union territory police send [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Three forces decide what reaches that table:

- **The law** decides who can be a rape victim at all.
- **NCRB's counting method** decides which table a case ends up in.
- **Silence and time** decide whether a case is ever registered, and when the public gets to see it.

Knowing which force made a gap tells you whether better counting could ever close it.

## People the law does not count

**1. Wives raped by their husbands.** Exception 2 to Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) says sexual intercourse or sexual acts by a man with his own wife, if she is not under 18, is not rape [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. So for married women, the most common perpetrator is the one the count cannot see. In the National Family Health Survey 2019-21, 82% of ever-married women aged 18 to 49 who had faced sexual violence named their current husband [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. A wife living separately can complain under Section 67, which carries 2 to 7 years [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. A wife living with her husband has no rape complaint to make.

**2. Adult men and transgender survivors.** Section 63 describes rape as something "a man" does to "a woman", and the BNS defines a woman as a female human being [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The new code also has no counterpart to Section 377 of the old Indian Penal Code, so non-consensual penetrative sex against an adult man or a transgender person is not rape, and no specific offence replaced it [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Boys under 18 remain protected by POCSO. Adult men and transgender survivors have no rape column to appear in.

Both gaps are made by law, so better counting cannot close them; only a change in the law can. (This is general information, not legal advice.)

## Cases filed somewhere else

**3. Most child victims.** Only 784 of the 29,536 rape cases involved girls under 18 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The rest of child rape sits in the POCSO table: 43,313 cases of penetrative or aggravated penetrative sexual assault on girls in 2024, involving 43,675 girls [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Boys appear in the chapter on crimes against children, which recorded 892 boys as victims of penetrative assault [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

**4. Rapes that ended in murder.** Under NCRB's "principal offence rule", an FIR with several offences is counted once, under the one with the heaviest punishment [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A rape followed by murder becomes "murder with rape": 266 cases, with 274 victims, in 2024, none of them in the rape figure [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

**5. Survivors with disabilities.** The only place disability appears in NCRB's rape data is a line for cases charged under the aggravated offence of raping a woman with a mental or physical disability: 144 of the 29,536 cases in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A disabled survivor whose case is filed as ordinary rape does not show up as disabled anywhere. In 2018, Human Rights Watch noted that neither NCRB nor the National Family Health Survey published data broken down by disability [[hrw-invisible-victims-2018]].

These three gaps come from NCRB's method and police practice. The child and murder cases can be added back from other tables; the disability gap cannot.

## Survivors who never report, and a two-year lag

**6. The many who never report.** A 2022 peer-reviewed study in *BMC Public Health* cited estimates that only about 1% of victims of sexual violence in India report it to the authorities [[bmcph-dandona-rape-data-2022]]. That is an estimate drawn from earlier research, not a measurement, but the household survey points the same way. Of women aged 18 to 49 who had faced physical or sexual violence, 77% never sought help or told anyone; of those who did seek help, only 6% went to the police [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. The rape figure measures who reached a police station and got an FIR, not how many people were raped.

**7. Anything after 2024.** *Crime in India 2024* was released on 6 May 2026 [[theprint-ncrb-cii-2024-release-2026]], and as of 20 November 2026 it is still NCRB's latest edition [[ncrb-website-cii-year-wise-2026]]. The BNS took effect on 1 July 2024 [[pib-new-criminal-laws-highlights-2024]], so there is no official count yet for 2025, the first full year under the new code. Any 2026 post quoting "this year's" rape count is describing 2024.

## A caveat you can copy

| Blind spot | What creates it | Can a reader add it back? |
|---|---|---|
| Wives; adult men and transgender survivors | The law: Section 63 of the BNS | No. Only a change in the law can |
| Most child rape; rapes ending in murder | NCRB's counting: the POCSO table and the principal offence rule | Yes, from the POCSO table and the murder-with-rape row |
| Survivors with disabilities | Only cases charged under the disability clause are flagged | No. The information is not recorded |
| Survivors who never report | Stigma and victim-blaming | No. Surveys get closer, not all the way |
| 2025 and 2026 | Publication lag | Only when NCRB publishes |

When you share a rape statistic, attach a line like this one:

> This is the number of rape cases police registered in India in 2024 (NCRB, Crime in India 2024). It leaves out rape by husbands, adult male and transgender survivors, most child rape (filed under POCSO), rapes that ended in murder, and the many survivors who never report. Read it as a floor, not a total.

It takes ten seconds to paste, and it stops a real number from telling a false story.
what-rape-statistics-cannot-show.hg:
2024 mein India mein police ne 29,536 rape cases register kiye, jinmein 29,742 victims the, yaani har lakh auraton par 4.3 cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Desh mein sexual violence par sabse zyada quote hone wala number yahi hai, aur yeh asli complaints ka asli record hai. Lekin is number ki seemaayein hain, aur unke bahar jo log hain, woh ittefaq se wahan nahi hain. Kuch ko law bahar rakhta hai, kuch ko National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) ka cases file karne ka tareeka, aur kuch ko chuppi aur waqt. Yeh rahe saat blind spots, aur har ek kahan se aata hai.

## Official number aur uski seemaayein

Rape figure un FIRs ko ginta hai jo rape sections ke tehat register hui, aur har FIR ko sirf ek baar. NCRB khud cases collect nahi karta; woh wahi compile karta hai jo states aur union territories ki police bhejti hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Us table tak kya pahunchega, yeh teen cheezein tay karti hain:

- **Law** tay karta hai ki rape ka victim ho kaun sakta hai.
- **NCRB ka counting method** tay karta hai ki koi case kis table mein jaayega.
- **Chuppi aur waqt** tay karte hain ki case kabhi register hoga bhi ya nahi, aur public use kab dekh paayegi.

Kaunsi cheez ne koi gap banaya, yeh jaan kar aap samajh sakte hain ki behtar counting use kabhi bhar bhi sakti hai ya nahi.

## Woh log jinhe law ginta hi nahi

**1. Woh patniyan jinka rape unke pati ne kiya.** Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 63 ka Exception 2 kehta hai ki agar patni 18 saal se kam ki nahi hai, toh aadmi ka apni patni ke saath sexual intercourse ya sexual acts rape nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Yaani shaadishuda auraton ke liye sabse aam perpetrator wahi hai jise yeh count dekh hi nahi sakta. National Family Health Survey 2019-21 mein, 18 se 49 saal ki jin ever-married auraton ne sexual violence jheli thi, unmein se 82% ne apne maujooda pati ka naam liya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Alag reh rahi patni Section 67 ke tehat complaint kar sakti hai, jismein 2 se 7 saal ki saza hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Lekin jo patni pati ke saath reh rahi hai, uske paas rape ki complaint karne ka koi raasta nahi hai.

**2. Adult mard aur transgender survivors.** Section 63 rape ko aisi cheez batata hai jo "a man" ek "a woman" ke saath karta hai, aur BNS aurat ko female human being ke roop mein define karta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Naye code mein purane Indian Penal Code ke Section 377 jaisa koi provision bhi nahi hai, isliye kisi adult mard ya transgender vyakti ke saath bina consent ka penetrative sex rape nahi hai, aur uski jagah koi specific offence nahi laaya gaya [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. 18 saal se kam umar ke ladke POCSO ke tehat protected hain. Lekin adult mardon aur transgender survivors ke liye koi rape column hi nahi hai jismein woh dikh sakein.

Dono gaps law ne banaye hain, isliye behtar counting inhe nahi bhar sakti; sirf law mein badlaav hi inhe bhar sakta hai. (Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.)

## Kahin aur file hue cases

**3. Zyadatar child victims.** 29,536 rape cases mein se sirf 784 mein 18 saal se kam umar ki ladkiyan thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Bachchon ke baaki rape cases POCSO table mein hain: 2024 mein ladkiyon par penetrative ya aggravated penetrative sexual assault ke 43,313 cases, jinmein 43,675 ladkiyan thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Ladke crimes against children wale chapter mein dikhte hain, jahan 892 ladke penetrative assault ke victims ke roop mein record hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

**4. Woh rapes jinke baad murder hua.** NCRB ke "principal offence rule" ke tehat, jis FIR mein kai offences hon, use ek hi baar gina jaata hai, us offence ke naam par jiski saza sabse bhaari ho [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Jis rape ke baad murder hua, woh "murder with rape" ban jaata hai: 2024 mein aise 266 cases the, 274 victims ke saath, aur inmein se ek bhi rape figure mein nahi hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

**5. Disability wale survivors.** NCRB ke rape data mein disability sirf ek jagah dikhti hai: un cases ki line mein jinmein mental ya physical disability wali aurat ke rape ka aggravated offence lagaya gaya. 2024 mein 29,536 mein se aise sirf 144 cases the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Agar kisi disability wale survivor ka case ordinary rape ke roop mein file hua, toh woh kahin bhi disabled ke roop mein nahi dikhta. 2018 mein Human Rights Watch ne note kiya tha ki na NCRB, na National Family Health Survey, disability ke hisaab se alag data publish karte the [[hrw-invisible-victims-2018]].

Yeh teeno gaps NCRB ke method aur police ke kaam karne ke tareeke se aate hain. Bachchon aur murder wale cases doosri tables se waapas jode ja sakte hain; disability wala gap nahi.

## Woh survivors jo kabhi report nahi karte, aur do saal ki deri

**6. Report na karne wale bahut saare log.** 2022 mein *BMC Public Health* mein chhapi ek peer-reviewed study ne un estimates ka hawala diya jinke mutabik India mein sexual violence ke sirf lagbhag 1% victims authorities ko report karte hain [[bmcph-dandona-rape-data-2022]]. Yeh pehle ki research se liya gaya estimate hai, koi naap nahi, lekin household survey bhi isi taraf ishaara karta hai. 18 se 49 saal ki jin auraton ne physical ya sexual violence jheli thi, unmein se 77% ne na kabhi madad maangi, na kisi ko bataya; aur jinhone madad maangi, unmein se sirf 6% police ke paas gayin [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Rape figure yeh naapta hai ki kaun police station tak pahuncha aur kiski FIR hui, yeh nahi ki kitne logon ka rape hua.

**7. 2024 ke baad ka kuch bhi.** *Crime in India 2024* 6 May 2026 ko release hui [[theprint-ncrb-cii-2024-release-2026]], aur 20 November 2026 tak yahi NCRB ka latest edition hai [[ncrb-website-cii-year-wise-2026]]. BNS 1 July 2024 se laagu hua [[pib-new-criminal-laws-highlights-2024]], isliye 2025 ka, jo naye code ke tehat pehla poora saal hai, abhi tak koi official count nahi hai. 2026 ki jo bhi post "is saal" ka rape count quote kare, woh asal mein 2024 ki baat kar rahi hai.

## Ek caveat jo aap copy kar sakte hain

| Blind spot | Ise kaun banata hai | Kya reader ise waapas jod sakta hai? |
|---|---|---|
| Patniyan; adult mard aur transgender survivors | Law: BNS ka Section 63 | Nahi. Sirf law mein badlaav se |
| Zyadatar child rape; murder par khatam hue rapes | NCRB ki counting: POCSO table aur principal offence rule | Haan, POCSO table aur murder-with-rape row se |
| Disability wale survivors | Sirf disability clause wale cases flag hote hain | Nahi. Yeh jaankari record hi nahi hoti |
| Report na karne wale survivors | Stigma aur victim-blaming | Nahi. Surveys kareeb pahunchte hain, poori tarah nahi |
| 2025 aur 2026 | Publish hone mein deri | Sirf jab NCRB publish kare |

Jab bhi aap koi rape statistic share karein, uske saath aisi ek line jodiye:

> Yeh 2024 mein India mein police dwara register kiye gaye rape cases ki sankhya hai (NCRB, Crime in India 2024). Ismein patiyon dwara kiya gaya rape, adult mard aur transgender survivors, zyadatar child rape (jo POCSO mein file hota hai), murder par khatam hue rapes, aur report na karne wale bahut saare survivors shaamil nahi hain. Ise kam se kam ki ginti samjhiye, poori ginti nahi.

Ise paste karne mein das second lagte hain, aur yeh ek sachche number ko jhoothi kahani sunane se rok deta hai.
